categories.description: Any% Unrestricted allows for all glitches to be used. I will be using an older and safer route to trigger the secret route earlier than the devs intended. The goal of the game is to get to the end of the new content as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Stanley came across two open doors, what could they mean? New... New content? We'll surely this is a surprise. The Stanley Parable is an experimental narrative-driven first-person game. It is an exploration of choice, freedom, storytelling and reality, all through the character known as Stanley. The choices you make, influenced or not by the Narrator, will create a different outcome and ending. Which one will you receive?
games.name: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe

categories.description: A fast paced category where you start with the chargeboots and all weapons unlocked. Viewers get to see a bit of almost every planet in the game as we rush between checkpoints using all the tools at our disposal.  Great showcase of the game with many flashy tricks, including some recent big skips
categories.name: NG+ no IMG

games.description: Beloved childhood classic and staple Playstation speedrun. Runners utilise the chargeboots to quickly reach max speed with, and a speedrun involves constantly weaving, redirecting and utilising that speed to get through each individual planet as fast as possible without stopping. Runs in most categories are heavily optimised leading to a fast-paced barrage of trick after trick with some of the most smooth movement in speedrunning connecting it all.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando

categories.description: Three runs revolutionised by holy grails. RaC1 NG+  will showcase the infamous Poki Skip for the 1st time, a sequence break skipping 3 planets. No IMG with race skip is now a breakneck speedrun with almost no breaks. UYA no QE has too many new tricks to count, including ELDF, which saves 5 minutes.
categories.name: Original Trilogy

categories.description: Extending the trilogy with the 4th game in the series. Deadlocked combines the movement system of the original games with a focus on precision and knowledge. It has also seen its own revolution in the last year with the insanely flashy Airswing, abusing enemy knockback to fly through the air.
categories.name: Original Quadrilogy

games.description: The Ratchet & Clank series is a staple of speedrun marathons, known for its incredibly deep movement system and insanely passionate community. Maybe it's because of this that the series has seen an explosion of new strats in recent years, saving minutes and raising the skill level of every game in the PS2 quadrilogy. We want to celebrate this new era of Ratchet speedrunning together at ESA with a back-to-back display of new strats & routes that have never been shown before at any marathon.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank Series Relay Showcase

categories.description: Moderniser is a community patch making this game run more smoothly on modern systems, but since it does change some of the backend, it's its own category. Any glitch is fair game.
categories.name: Moderniser%

games.description: A wonderful 1st person ARPG from 2002 with stealth elements. A satire of James Bond, very Austin Powers-y, where we play as a female agent, Cate Archer. Very fun spy game, lots of glitches and speedtech, top tier humour. This game is what Goldeneye wanted to be. While not super well known, people who know this game are massive fans, I'd love to try getting some of them on commentary, OR I could ask some known ESA people who are from countries this game is making fun of in its cute way.
games.name: No One Lives Forever 2: A Spy in H.A.R.M.'s Way

categories.description: Any glitch is fair game, and boy do we have some. I would probably have someone from Deus Ex community on commentary, maybe SuiMachine, maybe Cadarev. Heinki, sadly, will not be coming to this ESA.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The newest, and unfortunately the final, Deus Ex game. 1st person RPG set mostly in Prague, which is where I come from as well, which makes me uniquely qualified to make fun of the parody of a language Eidos Monteréal has the audacity to call "czech". But in its core, this game has a lot of fun tech, cool glitches, superhuman ability abuse, OOBs, you name it.
games.name: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided

categories.description: Complete the Phantom Liberty expansion on a new save, selecting the option to begin at the expansion - all without glitches!
categories.name: Phantom Liberty Any% Glitchless

games.description: Cyberpunk 2077 is a story-based first person shooter that features a mixture of platforming, boss fights and driving. The game features a mix of platforming, combat and driving over the course of the run. There is a decision to be made at the end of the run which can  be used for an incentive, namely if Songbird should be sent to the moon or given up to Reed.
games.name: Cyberpunk 2077

Ackman, written and illustrated by Akira Toriyama, the creator of Dragon Ball.
games.name: Go Go Ackman 3

games.description: What happens when you swap Donkey Kong for Mario in DKC1? Chaos! In this hilarious ROM hack, Mario spin-jumps, throws fireballs, and barrels through a world never meant for him. This meme-fueled race embraces absurd physics, cursed visuals, and nonstop laughs as we push Mario to his limits in a Donkey Kong-sized challenge. Get ready for DKC like you’ve never seen before – with extra spaghetti!
games.name: DKC X Mario

categories.description: GT Classic utilizes a debug code to get all major items. The beginning of the category consists of getting as few items as possible to enter a late game area where you activate the code. Afterwards the run is essentially a boss rush with full loadout. Commentary for GTC: Sorenlol + gebbu
categories.name: GT Classic

categories.description: For coop runs, we use a program which connects 2 games RAM to syncs item pickups, ammunition, health, and boss flags. This allows us to mitigate some of the early game danger in GTC by allowing one runner to farm for the other. Commentary for GTC Co-op: gebbu + Dyce_NL
categories.name: Co-op GT Classic

categories.description: This exhibition is intended as a bonus run after any Super Metroid run. Run would be done in practice rom in case of crashes. The run would showcase the use of a glitched beam to do wrong warps and save the baby. Then more wrong warps to trigger endgame. Commentary for Save the Baby: Sorenlol
categories.name: Save the Baby glitch exhibition

games.description: Super Metroid is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game, which primarily takes place on the fictional planet Zebes from the original game—a large, open-ended world with areas connected by doors and elevators.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: This category involves quite a bit of collection with my specific route needing to acquire 800 gems as well as the main necessity being to get to the end of each level to collect its Talisman (14 in total) as fast as possible while taking on the occasional boss here and there before fighting Ripto!
categories.name: 14 Talisman

categories.description: This category similar to 14 talisman is one that focuses on gathering gems and talismans, however in addition to these we'll be gathering the games main collectible which are orbs. If and when we collect 40 of them it opens up the final boss and allows us in to fight him! It's essentially any% NMS!
categories.name: 40 Orb

categories.description: The specific goal of this category is to 100% complete the game as fast as humanly possible. This run features a sick little taste of what any% looks like to start as we gain all abilities by beating Ripto and tread through the completion portion using the fireball powerup! It's lit ^-^

The goal of this game is to use spyro 2's unique movement engine to beat the game in as little time as humanly possible! It's basically just a rush through the main bosses of Crush, Gulp and the game's namesake Ripto!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage is the sequel to the original Spyro The Dragon, in this new adventure Spyro takes on the likes on Ripto to take back the world of Avalar from his clutches. This specific speedrun of Spyro 2 involves us doing exactly what Elora told us at the start of the game and that is collecting the 14 Talismans as well as orbs in the Summer Forest and Autumn Plains home worlds. We then make it into the third and final home world Winter Tundra to confront Ripto using some fun tricks!
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: For the current run of Year of The Dragon any% we do not have access to a sorceress skip, meaning that we have to meet the 100 egg requirement to open the door to the final boss in hub 4. Each level has loads of tricks to advance through to grab eggs as well as maintain a steady gem count.
categories.name: Year of The Dragon Any%

games.description: For the main Any% route we need to get both 100 of the game's main collectible "Eggs" across the whole of it to open the final boss door at the end of the game. This is accomplished through awesome movement, gem collection, out of bounds sections, item storages, and many other rad tricks!
games.name: Spyro Reignited Trilogy

categories.description: The intention is to utilize as many tricks as possible to make into and to the end of level in each of the first three hubs as fast as possible. In it there isn't so much as a moment of missed action where we need to detour for extra eggs or gems as we focus on getting to the final boss instead.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: The goal of this category is to beat Spyro 3 the dev intended way of opening the sorceress door via collecting 100 eggs as fast as humanly possible. This route features dynamic and fun routing, exciting tricks and a whole lot of purple dragon to go around!
categories.name: 100 Egg

games.description: The game itself was made and produced in the year 2000 aka the chinese year of the dragon as the third installment in Insomniac's Spyro the Dragon series. In it Spyro and friends look to take back the eggs and forgotten realms from the Sorceress This run is the single most trick intensive run in the whole of the game as it features a myriad of proxies to reach the end of levels for the first three hubs until we use another squeeze proxy to finish off the game by making it into the final boss.
games.name: Spyro: Year of The Dragon

categories.description: Vortex is the latest Spyro main category where we utilize the all levels cheat code to bypass all the normal requirements to advance through the game. With this we go to every world barring flight levels with the intention of exiting through the "vortex" aka return home portal as fast as possible
categories.name: Vortex

games.description: Spyro the dragon is a 90's platformer which features the namesake character at the helm as he struggles to take back the dragon realms from the clutches of Gnasty Gnorc. The game itself features stellar music and phenomenal level designs which bring the game to life in a way that few games from that era have been able to do.
games.name: Spyro The Dragon

categories.description: All Duelists implies by the name that the intention of the category is to play and defeat all duelists in the game. However, use of the 15 card mod allows for us to secure more consistent drops and generally get through the game faster/more consistently. The game also features some awesome music!
categories.name: All Duelists 15 Card

games.description: This game is something of an early build of what would become the actual yugioh card game and was heavily inspired by the original mangas printed for the series way back when. However due to its release date technically predating the actual card game, this game and the actual TCG that came out after it share little more than basic mechanics. The method of progression is willing duels and by upgrading your deck with the cards given to you by beating other duelists. It's basically all rng and fun~
games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories

categories.description: As implied by the name this is the no out of bounds category, but by no means does that mean there are no skips. Through use of the geometry and the different abilities Glyde's elements provide us we seek to gather as many as needed to gain access to the final boss before promptly defeating them!
categories.name: Any% No Oob

games.description: Glyde The Dragon is a demo at it's current stage, but is an upcoming full title that myself and  ShempOfficial provide voice over work for(Which we can do our commentary as for potential incentives.) The game takes heavy inspiration from the hack and slash genre, citing inspirations such as Devil May Cry and The Legend of Spyro series. In this game you play as the yellow dragon and master of all elements Glyde as he seeks to mend the corruption of invading forces that look to destroy the world!
games.name: Glyde The Dragon

categories.description: Beat the game - any ending. Some glitches are not performed in marathon runs, as some tricks take a significant amount of RTA time to perform (but save time with LRT). Essentially go OP in the tutorial, shoot people who want to talk to you, hope the game doesn't crashes.
categories.name: any%

games.description: An infamous sequel to Deus Ex, full of technical issues and glitches and occasional out of the box solutions for problems to go faster.
games.name: Deus Ex: Invisible War

categories.description: Beat the game. The standard. We skip many cutscenes and slow walking sections using clipping. Occasionally cancel fall damage using abilities that you can get in the game.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Crysis 2 is a sequel to famous PC benchmark. It's more straightforward and more story heavy than first game. As far as run, a lot of it is going OOB, often to skip cutscenes - there is quite a few skips, but also quite a few long cutscenes that are unskippable. Some of the tricks are hard to perform, which is in part why the estimate is so high. Many of people from speedfam helped me route it many, many years ago.
games.name: Crysis 2

categories.description: Just beat the game as quickly trying to optimise some boss fights, not get swarmed by enemies and not run out of health - although I am pretty sure they call it Czechoslovakian Quake mostly because of the colour pallet.
categories.name: any%

games.description: A very weird Czech indie boomer shooter set in post-apocalyptic Czechoslovakia with many obscure and funny references to Czech and Czechoslovakian popculture. While it doesn't feature any complicated movement tech like bunny hopping, it's still fast and difficult.
games.name: HROT

categories.description: All Tournaments involves beating all Tournaments to finish the game! This category has a lot of gimmick races as the game progresses. The crazy fast Backwards driving and jumping allows us to do insanely cool skips on rather long tracks.
categories.name: All Tournaments

games.description: Looney Tunes: Space Race is a Port from Dreamcast, that actually has some differences compared to what is available on the Dreamcast version, and also a very hype and interesting mechanic that was completely overlooked. The main movement of the game is DRIVING BACKWARDS. It has some interesting depth besides backwards driving, which will allow us to exploit a lot of tracks! Most tournaments are split with gimmicky races to create variation, that are very hard to deal with for Casual players!
games.name: Looney Tunes: Space Race

categories.description: Any% in this game consists of either rapidly navigating Spider-Man's web-swinging or clipping through everything imaginable to hit the end-of-level trigger hidden underneath the maps! I will also wear a Spider-Man suit during the run!
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: Spider-Man PS1 is full of very rapid mid-air movement and 'blink and you miss it' out-of-bounds tricks! This game hasn't gotten a lot of time on the big screen and I genuinely think this being showcased would turn a lot of heads! One of the highlights of the run is that the last section is a stressful chase level from the final boss that would get a lot of the audience glued to the run. Also, Any% allows 3 different costumes, so we can have donation incentives for people's favorite suit!
games.name: Spider-Man (2000)

categories.description: Gemless% refers to not using the Gem power-ups that are usually unlocked in the original game's campaign. They can give Sonic different abilities like infinite jump, quick boosts, shields, etc. Gemless basically creates a beginner-friendly Any% which helps you get used to how insanely fast it is!
categories.name: Gemless%

games.description: Sonic Project '06 (or Sonic P-06) is a fan remake of Sonic '06 for the PC. The main difference is that this version fixes basically all of the problems the base game had on consoles. Not only that, but it introduces a bunch of new custom gameplay mechanics, which we take advantage of for these runs. For example, we can a enable Sonic Heroes style homing attack which is used for basically every run to instigate momentum!
games.name: Sonic Project '06

categories.description: You're tasked with completing the game by only collecting the 14 required talismans at the end of every level, skipping optional orbs, and utilizing a plethora of out-of-bounds tricks and very rapid-fire movement!
categories.name: 14 Talisman

categories.description: This would be a fun bonus run or a backup run in case we ever needed it. Or if Spyro 2 is accepted already, we could pair this with it for fun.  True Love% requires you to get to the Romeo & Juliet mission in the second homeworld.
categories.name: True Love%

games.description: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! follows Spyro's quest to save Avalar from the villainous Ripto. He collects talismans across diverse realms, gains new abilities, and interacts with quirky characters. With vibrant visuals and engaging gameplay, it's a beloved classic in PlayStation history.
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: Any% is an insanely fun category to watch. There's a massive amount of funny-looking tricks and widely interesting movement tech like Journal Launch, Air Walking, etc. It's also a fantastic game for incentives!
categories.name: Any% (Single Run)

games.description: Uncharted 2 follows treasure hunter Nathan Drake on a quest for the fabled Cintamani Stone. With exhilarating action, breathtaking visuals, and compelling storytelling, Drake navigates through perilous landscapes, facing off against mercenaries and unraveling ancient mysteries. The game's seamless blend of platforming, gunplay, and puzzle-solving creates an unforgettable adventure.
games.name: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves

categories.description: I consider 100 Egg to be the beginner's category for Spyro 3 running! The goal is to collect 100 Eggs in a very specific/optimized route and get to the final boss as fast as possible! People are VERY familiar with this game, so seeing it represented at all would bring in a large crowd!
categories.name: 100 Egg

games.description: This game continues the adventures of the beloved purple dragon as he sets out to recover stolen dragon eggs. Across vibrant worlds, Spyro confronts enemies, solves puzzles, and completes challenges. With diverse gameplay including platforming, mini-games, and character-switching, it offers a rich, colorful experience. Collectibles, secret areas, and charming characters add depth to this classic PlayStation platformer.
games.name: Spyro: Year of the Dragon

categories.description: Any% is the quintessential category for Croc 2. It sees you go from the start of the game, to beating the final boss, with all the glitches that the game has to offer allowed for the speedrun.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Croc 2 is a platformer for the PS1 that sees you traverse 4 worlds, battling pits, tricky jumps, and bosses. This game as a speedrun however allows for a lot of eye catching tricks and tech that are not often associated with a 3D platformer of its kind, allowing for a unique showcase that sets it apart from Croc 1, and other games in the genre. (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Croc 2

categories.description: 101% (Glitched) involves completing the Adventure Mode of CTR, including all collectables that are available. This run allows all the glitches that are in the game, leading to this category being the best showcase of both the tight racing and satisfying, crazy glitches that CTR offers.

games.description: CTR is a Racing game for the PS1 that has everything that a racing game should have, Technical driving, cornering and drifting that is simple to understand, difficult to master but easy to explain fundamentals, and insane skips that are easy on the eye. This game is a perfect example of a racing game that lends itself to speedrunning. (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Crash Team Racing

categories.description: This speedrun would do all 3 main categories in each of the respective games, Any% No Major Glitches for CTR, Any% for CNK, and Any% No Penguin Spacewalking (PSW) for CTTR.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This run involves all 3 main line Crash Bandicoot racing games, Crash Team Racing, Crash Nitro Kart, and Crash Tag Team Racing. All 3 of these games are excellent for this type of event, with CTTR  never being shown at an ESA prior to this one.
games.name: Crash Bandicoot Racing Trifecta

categories.description: Any% (No Penguin Spacewalking) is the standard category for Crash Tag Team Racing, and requires you to go through the 5 worlds and beat the game with only banning 1 tech. (that is not marathon safe) every other glitch is allowed, enabling quite the showcase.
categories.name: Any% (No PSW)

games.description: CTTR is both a Platformer, and a Racing game that combines both genres to make a wildly fascinating speedrun. This game truly has it all, having both skips and technical movement, in both the genres that the game has you play. A speedrun that has not been seen in a marathon of this size ever before, and is sure to raise a few eyebrows.
games.name: Crash Tag Team Racing

categories.description: 96 Tracks (200cc, Items On) involves beating every single track in the game, on the fastest speed setting, with the items on, meaning there is a fair amount of RNG, but the speed of the run is still a great watch. The ideal category for a speedrun marathon.
categories.name: 96 Tracks (200cc, Items On)

games.description: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe is a Kart Racer for the Nintendo Switch and is widely regarded as the quintessential kart racer of the current console generation. It is the perfect game for a showcase such as this due to the combination of easy to understand gameplay as well as flashy skips.
games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

categories.description: Any% is the standard category of Crash Nitro Kart, all glitches, shortcuts, and skips are allowed, meaning that this is the perfect category to show off what CNK is all about.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Crash Nitro Kart is a very similar game to Crash Team Racing, however Crash Nitro Kart has over the last year evolved in to something far removed from its predecessor. CNK now has some how even more baffling skips than it did a few years ago, whilst still keeping the things that made it great to watch, being taking tight lines to go as fast as you can, and putting a premium on consistency. Coupling this with the new skips that have been found makes for an incredible watch.
games.name: Crash Nitro Kart

categories.description: This category sees you beat every "Acme Challenge" in the game,  which translates to beating all the missions the game has. Similarly to Mario Kart DS' mission mode, this offers a wide variety in what will be seen, from racing to collection minigames.
categories.name: All Acme Challenges

games.description: Looney Tunes Racing is a Playstation racer built around the characters of the famous Looney Tunes Cartoons. It is an incredibly easy racing game to understand from a viewing perspective, but has enough intricacies to be a fun and engaging watch.
games.name: Looney Tunes Racing

categories.description: Any% involves beating all 8 races in the game, and getting to the "Beat the game" screen. (In the video submission, runs starts at 5:22:40)
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Formula Karts is a Playstation 1 Kart Racer that was released in Europe only, hence how niche and unknown this game is. Formula Karts sees you race in different parts of the world, starting in Germany and ending in Egypt, with every race having a single goal, win. A very easy to understand game, with an amazing soundtrack, that has never been seen before by pretty much everyone!
games.name: Formula Karts: Special Edition

categories.description: In 32 Track speedrun you try to complete each track as fast as possible. No skips means you aren't allowed to do any of the game breaking lap glitches. It is a more marathon friendly category since its not relying on making hard glitches but allows to showcase each track and its shortcuts, strats.
categories.name: 32 Track - No Skips

games.description: Racing game with 12 racers. Speedruns in Mario Kart Wii Complete 16/32 tracks as fast as they can.
games.name: Mario Kart Wii

categories.description: Any% Unrestricted allows for all glitches to be used. I will be using an older and safer route to trigger the secret route earlier than the devs intended. The goal of the game is to get to the end of the new content as fast as possible.
categories.name: Any%

Viewers get to see a bit of almost every planet in the game as we rush between checkpoints using all the tools at our disposal. categories.name: Moderniser%

games.description: A wonderful 1st person ARPG from 2002 with stealth elements. A satire of James Bond, very Austin Powers-y, where we play as a female agent, Cate Archer. Very fun spy game, lots of glitches and speedtech, top tier humour. This game is what Goldeneye wanted to be. While not super well known, people who know this game are massive fans, I'd love to try getting some of them on commentary, OR I could ask some known ESA people who are from countries this game is making fun of in its cute way.
games.name: No One Lives Forever 2: A Spy in H.A.R.M.'s Way

categories.description: Any glitch is fair game, and boy do we have some. I would probably have someone from Deus Ex community on commentary, maybe SuiMachine, maybe Cadarev. Heinki, sadly, will not be coming to this ESA.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The newest, and unfortunately the final, Deus Ex game. 1st person RPG set mostly in Prague, which is where I come from as well, which makes me uniquely qualified to make fun of the parody of a language Eidos Monteréal has the audacity to call "czech". But in its core, this game has a lot of fun tech, cool glitches, superhuman ability abuse, OOBs, you name it.
games.name: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided

categories.description: Complete the Phantom Liberty expansion on a new save, selecting the option to begin at the expansion - all without glitches!
categories.name: Phantom Liberty Any% Glitchless

The game features a mix of platforming, combat and driving over the course of the run. There is a decision to be made at the end of the run which can  be used for an incentive, namely if Songbird should be sent to the moon or given up to Reed.
games.name: Cyberpunk 2077

Ackman, written and illustrated by Akira Toriyama, the creator of Dragon Ball.

This meme-fueled race embraces absurd physics, cursed visuals, and nonstop laughs as we push Mario to his limits in a Donkey Kong-sized challenge. Get ready for DKC like you’ve never seen before – with extra spaghetti!

categories.description: GT Classic utilizes a debug code to get all major items. The beginning of the category consists of getting as few items as possible to enter a late game area where you activate the code. Afterwards the run is essentially a boss rush with full loadout. Commentary for GTC: Sorenlol + gebbu
categories.name: GT Classic

categories.description: For coop runs, we use a program which connects 2 games RAM to syncs item pickups, ammunition, health, and boss flags. This allows us to mitigate some of the early game danger in GTC by allowing one runner to farm for the other. Commentary for GTC Co-op: gebbu + Dyce_NL
categories.name: Co-op GT Classic

categories.description: This exhibition is intended as a bonus run after any Super Metroid run. Run would be done in practice rom in case of crashes. The run would showcase the use of a glitched beam to do wrong warps and save the baby. Then more wrong warps to trigger endgame. Commentary for Save the Baby: Sorenlol
categories.name: Save the Baby glitch exhibition

games.description: Super Metroid is a 2D side-scrolling action-adventure game, which primarily takes place on the fictional planet Zebes from the original game—a large, open-ended world with areas connected by doors and elevators.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: This category involves quite a bit of collection with my specific route needing to acquire 800 gems as well as the main necessity being to get to the end of each level to collect its Talisman (14 in total) as fast as possible while taking on the occasional boss here and there before fighting Ripto!
categories.name: 14 Talisman

categories.description: This category similar to 14 talisman is one that focuses on gathering gems and talismans, however in addition to these we'll be gathering the games main collectible which are orbs. If and when we collect 40 of them it opens up the final boss and allows us in to fight him! It's essentially any% NMS!
categories.name: 40 Orb

categories.description: The specific goal of this category is to 100% complete the game as fast as humanly possible. This run features a sick little taste of what any% looks like to start as we gain all abilities by beating Ripto and tread through the completion portion using the fireball powerup! It's lit ^-^

The goal of this game is to use spyro 2's unique movement engine to beat the game in as little time as humanly possible! It's basically just a rush through the main bosses of Crush, Gulp and the game's namesake Ripto!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage is the sequel to the original Spyro The Dragon, in this new adventure Spyro takes on the likes on Ripto to take back the world of Avalar from his clutches. This specific speedrun of Spyro 2 involves us doing exactly what Elora told us at the start of the game and that is collecting the 14 Talismans as well as orbs in the Summer Forest and Autumn Plains home worlds. We then make it into the third and final home world Winter Tundra to confront Ripto using some fun tricks!
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: For the current run of Year of The Dragon any% we do not have access to a sorceress skip, meaning that we have to meet the 100 egg requirement to open the door to the final boss in hub 4. Each level has loads of tricks to advance through to grab eggs as well as maintain a steady gem count.
categories.name: Year of The Dragon Any%

games.description: For the main Any% route we need to get both 100 of the game's main collectible "Eggs" across the whole of it to open the final boss door at the end of the game. This is accomplished through awesome movement, gem collection, out of bounds sections, item storages, and many other rad tricks!
games.name: Spyro Reignited Trilogy

categories.description: The intention is to utilize as many tricks as possible to make into and to the end of level in each of the first three hubs as fast as possible. In it there isn't so much as a moment of missed action where we need to detour for extra eggs or gems as we focus on getting to the final boss instead.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: The goal of this category is to beat Spyro 3 the dev intended way of opening the sorceress door via collecting 100 eggs as fast as humanly possible. This route features dynamic and fun routing, exciting tricks and a whole lot of purple dragon to go around!
categories.name: 100 Egg

games.description: The game itself was made and produced in the year 2000 aka the chinese year of the dragon as the third installment in Insomniac's Spyro the Dragon series. In it Spyro and friends look to take back the eggs and forgotten realms from the Sorceress This run is the single most trick intensive run in the whole of the game as it features a myriad of proxies to reach the end of levels for the first three hubs until we use another squeeze proxy to finish off the game by making it into the final boss.
games.name: Spyro: Year of The Dragon

categories.description: Vortex is the latest Spyro main category where we utilize the all levels cheat code to bypass all the normal requirements to advance through the game. With this we go to every world barring flight levels with the intention of exiting through the "vortex" aka return home portal as fast as possible
categories.name: Vortex

games.description: Spyro the dragon is a 90's platformer which features the namesake character at the helm as he struggles to take back the dragon realms from the clutches of Gnasty Gnorc. The game itself features stellar music and phenomenal level designs which bring the game to life in a way that few games from that era have been able to do.
games.name: Spyro The Dragon

categories.description: All Duelists implies by the name that the intention of the category is to play and defeat all duelists in the game. However, use of the 15 card mod allows for us to secure more consistent drops and generally get through the game faster/more consistently. The game also features some awesome music!
categories.name: All Duelists 15 Card

games.description: This game is something of an early build of what would become the actual yugioh card game and was heavily inspired by the original mangas printed for the series way back when. However due to its release date technically predating the actual card game, this game and the actual TCG that came out after it share little more than basic mechanics. The method of progression is willing duels and by upgrading your deck with the cards given to you by beating other duelists. It's basically all rng and fun~
games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories

categories.description: As implied by the name this is the no out of bounds category, but by no means does that mean there are no skips. Through use of the geometry and the different abilities Glyde's elements provide us we seek to gather as many as needed to gain access to the final boss before promptly defeating them!
categories.name: Any% No Oob

games.description: Glyde The Dragon is a demo at it's current stage, but is an upcoming full title that myself and  ShempOfficial provide voice over work for(Which we can do our commentary as for potential incentives.) The game takes heavy inspiration from the hack and slash genre, citing inspirations such as Devil May Cry and The Legend of Spyro series. In this game you play as the yellow dragon and master of all elements Glyde as he seeks to mend the corruption of invading forces that look to destroy the world!
games.name: Glyde The Dragon

categories.description: Beat the game - any ending. Some glitches are not performed in marathon runs, as some tricks take a significant amount of RTA time to perform (but save time with LRT). Essentially go OP in the tutorial, shoot people who want to talk to you, hope the game doesn't crashes.
categories.name: any%

games.description: An infamous sequel to Deus Ex, full of technical issues and glitches and occasional out of the box solutions for problems to go faster.
games.name: Deus Ex: Invisible War

categories.description: Beat the game. The standard. We skip many cutscenes and slow walking sections using clipping. Occasionally cancel fall damage using abilities that you can get in the game.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Crysis 2 is a sequel to famous PC benchmark. It's more straightforward and more story heavy than first game. As far as run, a lot of it is going OOB, often to skip cutscenes - there is quite a few skips, but also quite a few long cutscenes that are unskippable. Some of the tricks are hard to perform, which is in part why the estimate is so high. Many of people from speedfam helped me route it many, many years ago.
games.name: Crysis 2

categories.description: Just beat the game as quickly trying to optimise some boss fights, not get swarmed by enemies and not run out of health - although I am pretty sure they call it Czechoslovakian Quake mostly because of the colour pallet.
categories.name: any%

games.description: A very weird Czech indie boomer shooter set in post-apocalyptic Czechoslovakia with many obscure and funny references to Czech and Czechoslovakian popculture. While it doesn't feature any complicated movement tech like bunny hopping, it's still fast and difficult.
games.name: HROT

categories.description: All Tournaments involves beating all Tournaments to finish the game! This category has a lot of gimmick races as the game progresses. The crazy fast Backwards driving and jumping allows us to do insanely cool skips on rather long tracks.
categories.name: All Tournaments

games.description: Looney Tunes: Space Race is a Port from Dreamcast, that actually has some differences compared to what is available on the Dreamcast version, and also a very hype and interesting mechanic that was completely overlooked. The main movement of the game is DRIVING BACKWARDS. It has some interesting depth besides backwards driving, which will allow us to exploit a lot of tracks! Most tournaments are split with gimmicky races to create variation, that are very hard to deal with for Casual players!
games.name: Looney Tunes: Space Race

categories.description: Any% in this game consists of either rapidly navigating Spider-Man's web-swinging or clipping through everything imaginable to hit the end-of-level trigger hidden underneath the maps! I will also wear a Spider-Man suit during the run!
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: Spider-Man PS1 is full of very rapid mid-air movement and 'blink and you miss it' out-of-bounds tricks! This game hasn't gotten a lot of time on the big screen and I genuinely think this being showcased would turn a lot of heads! One of the highlights of the run is that the last section is a stressful chase level from the final boss that would get a lot of the audience glued to the run. Also, Any% allows 3 different costumes, so we can have donation incentives for people's favorite suit!
games.name: Spider-Man (2000)

categories.description: Gemless% refers to not using the Gem power-ups that are usually unlocked in the original game's campaign. They can give Sonic different abilities like infinite jump, quick boosts, shields, etc. Gemless basically creates a beginner-friendly Any% which helps you get used to how insanely fast it is!
categories.name: Gemless%

games.description: Sonic Project '06 (or Sonic P-06) is a fan remake of Sonic '06 for the PC. The main difference is that this version fixes basically all of the problems the base game had on consoles. Not only that, but it introduces a bunch of new custom gameplay mechanics, which we take advantage of for these runs. For example, we can a enable Sonic Heroes style homing attack which is used for basically every run to instigate momentum!
games.name: Sonic Project '06

categories.description: You're tasked with completing the game by only collecting the 14 required talismans at the end of every level, skipping optional orbs, and utilizing a plethora of out-of-bounds tricks and very rapid-fire movement!
categories.name: 14 Talisman

categories.description: This would be a fun bonus run or a backup run in case we ever needed it. Or if Spyro 2 is accepted already, we could pair this with it for fun.  True Love% requires you to get to the Romeo & Juliet mission in the second homeworld.
categories.name: True Love%

games.description: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! follows Spyro's quest to save Avalar from the villainous Ripto. He collects talismans across diverse realms, gains new abilities, and interacts with quirky characters. With vibrant visuals and engaging gameplay, it's a beloved classic in PlayStation history.
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: Any% is an insanely fun category to watch. There's a massive amount of funny-looking tricks and widely interesting movement tech like Journal Launch, Air Walking, etc. It's also a fantastic game for incentives!
categories.name: Any% (Single Run)

games.description: Uncharted 2 follows treasure hunter Nathan Drake on a quest for the fabled Cintamani Stone. With exhilarating action, breathtaking visuals, and compelling storytelling, Drake navigates through perilous landscapes, facing off against mercenaries and unraveling ancient mysteries. The game's seamless blend of platforming, gunplay, and puzzle-solving creates an unforgettable adventure.
games.name: Uncharted 2: Among Thieves

categories.description: I consider 100 Egg to be the beginner's category for Spyro 3 running! The goal is to collect 100 Eggs in a very specific/optimized route and get to the final boss as fast as possible! People are VERY familiar with this game, so seeing it represented at all would bring in a large crowd!
categories.name: 100 Egg

games.description: This game continues the adventures of the beloved purple dragon as he sets out to recover stolen dragon eggs. Across vibrant worlds, Spyro confronts enemies, solves puzzles, and completes challenges. With diverse gameplay including platforming, mini-games, and character-switching, it offers a rich, colorful experience. Collectibles, secret areas, and charming characters add depth to this classic PlayStation platformer.
games.name: Spyro: Year of the Dragon

categories.description: Any% is the quintessential category for Croc 2. It sees you go from the start of the game, to beating the final boss, with all the glitches that the game has to offer allowed for the speedrun.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Croc 2 is a platformer for the PS1 that sees you traverse 4 worlds, battling pits, tricky jumps, and bosses. This game as a speedrun however allows for a lot of eye catching tricks and tech that are not often associated with a 3D platformer of its kind, allowing for a unique showcase that sets it apart from Croc 1, and other games in the genre. (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Croc 2

categories.description: 101% (Glitched) involves completing the Adventure Mode of CTR, including all collectables that are available. This run allows all the glitches that are in the game, leading to this category being the best showcase of both the tight racing and satisfying, crazy glitches that CTR offers.

games.description: CTR is a Racing game for the PS1 that has everything that a racing game should have, Technical driving, cornering and drifting that is simple to understand, difficult to master but easy to explain fundamentals, and insane skips that are easy on the eye. This game is a perfect example of a racing game that lends itself to speedrunning. (This game is ran on PS2 for faster loads)
games.name: Crash Team Racing

categories.description: This speedrun would do all 3 main categories in each of the respective games, Any% No Major Glitches for CTR, Any% for CNK, and Any% No Penguin Spacewalking (PSW) for CTTR.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This run involves all 3 main line Crash Bandicoot racing games, Crash Team Racing, Crash Nitro Kart, and Crash Tag Team Racing. All 3 of these games are excellent for this type of event, with CTTR  never being shown at an ESA prior to this one.
games.name: Crash Bandicoot Racing Trifecta

categories.description: Any% (No Penguin Spacewalking) is the standard category for Crash Tag Team Racing, and requires you to go through the 5 worlds and beat the game with only banning 1 tech. (that is not marathon safe) every other glitch is allowed, enabling quite the showcase.
categories.name: Any% (No PSW)

games.description: CTTR is both a Platformer, and a Racing game that combines both genres to make a wildly fascinating speedrun. This game truly has it all, having both skips and technical movement, in both the genres that the game has you play. A speedrun that has not been seen in a marathon of this size ever before, and is sure to raise a few eyebrows.
games.name: Crash Tag Team Racing

categories.description: 96 Tracks (200cc, Items On) involves beating every single track in the game, on the fastest speed setting, with the items on, meaning there is a fair amount of RNG, but the speed of the run is still a great watch. The ideal category for a speedrun marathon.
categories.name: 96 Tracks (200cc, Items On)

games.description: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe is a Kart Racer for the Nintendo Switch and is widely regarded as the quintessential kart racer of the current console generation. It is the perfect game for a showcase such as this due to the combination of easy to understand gameplay as well as flashy skips.
games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe

categories.description: Any% is the standard category of Crash Nitro Kart, all glitches, shortcuts, and skips are allowed, meaning that this is the perfect category to show off what CNK is all about.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Crash Nitro Kart is a very similar game to Crash Team Racing, however Crash Nitro Kart has over the last year evolved in to something far removed from its predecessor. CNK now has some how even more baffling skips than it did a few years ago, whilst still keeping the things that made it great to watch, being taking tight lines to go as fast as you can, and putting a premium on consistency. Coupling this with the new skips that have been found makes for an incredible watch.
games.name: Crash Nitro Kart

categories.description: This category sees you beat every "Acme Challenge" in the game,  which translates to beating all the missions the game has. Similarly to Mario Kart DS' mission mode, this offers a wide variety in what will be seen, from racing to collection minigames.
categories.name: All Acme Challenges

games.description: Looney Tunes Racing is a Playstation racer built around the characters of the famous Looney Tunes Cartoons. It is an incredibly easy racing game to understand from a viewing perspective, but has enough intricacies to be a fun and engaging watch.
games.name: Looney Tunes Racing

categories.description: Any% involves beating all 8 races in the game, and getting to the "Beat the game" screen. (In the video submission, runs starts at 5:22:40)
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Formula Karts is a Playstation 1 Kart Racer that was released in Europe only, hence how niche and unknown this game is. Formula Karts sees you race in different parts of the world, starting in Germany and ending in Egypt, with every race having a single goal, win. A very easy to understand game, with an amazing soundtrack, that has never been seen before by pretty much everyone!
games.name: Formula Karts: Special Edition

categories.description: In 32 Track speedrun you try to complete each track as fast as possible. No skips means you aren't allowed to do any of the game breaking lap glitches. It is a more marathon friendly category since its not relying on making hard glitches but allows to showcase each track and its shortcuts, strats.
categories.name: 32 Track - No Skips

games.description: Racing game with 12 racers. Speedruns in Mario Kart Wii Complete 16/32 tracks as fast as they can.
games.name: Mario Kart Wii

categories.description: It might no be the flashiest speedrun, but the music and atmosphere (~vibe~) makes up for it!
categories.name: Easy Mode

games.description:
Isometric platformer/shooter that Junkyard_Dave forced me to play!
This game just screams "90s" and "metal" :D
games.name: Skeleton Krew

categories.description: Beat the game. I will attempt all the tricks
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Amazing soundtrack and fast paced action. Not seen too often at marathons I believe. Also have to show off the death warps! :)
games.name: Journey to Silius

categories.description: After a lot of running around for the first ~3 minutes it turns into an intense boss rush in the later half. I will attempt all of the flashy boss fights with chains and boxes and various environmental hazards (current WR route).
categories.name: Novice

games.description: River City Ransom is a beat em up -style game with a lot of boss fights and satisfying game play packed into only a few minute of run time :)
games.name: River City Ransom

categories.description: A speedrun of Episode 2 of the game, featuring lots of movement tech, like disguise jumps, circle boosts, cutscene skips etc. Lots of different character section, vehicle minigames and variety makes for a well-rounded run experience.
categories.name: Episode 2

games.description: Sly 3 is a stylish 3D platformer with a lot of cool movement tech, where you go through episodes divided into jobs. The game is commonly run as either a full game run around 6 hours or as a single episode at a time, just short of an hour each.
games.name: Sly 3 Honor Among Theives

categories.description:
Different runners are selected to play each of the 20 tracks in the game. The AI is laughably easy, so winning is not going to be an issue. The run heavily relies on good item RNG for a fast time, the crowd will be yelling "Big Urn!" As players get lucky

The hosts will be ThaRixer and I
categories.name: Any% Relay

games.description: Released for the PlayStation in 2001, Monster Racer is a PAL exclusive racing game that closely resembles a student tech demo. It's simple, It's funny, It's prime meme material
games.name: Monster Racer

categories.description:
Easy mode has less enemies than normal mode and also skips a few stages at the end.
In any% Out-of-bounds tricks are used to skip a lot of several stages, also some stages are skipped completely thanks to branching paths.
categories.name: any% Easy

categories.description: Difference to any% is that no stages get completely skipped, we visit them all. But parts of stages will still be skipped with Out-of-Bounds tricks.
categories.name: All Stages Easy

games.description: This is a somewhat hidden gem of the NES and one of the most expensive games on the console due to being released late. A platformer where you can switch between 4 different characters (Human, Dragon, Mouse and Golem) that have different abilities and strengths. The speedrun mainly uses the mouse due to the fastest running speed and insanely fast boss kills if done right but as a downside she has very little health.
games.name: Little Samson

categories.description: Major Glitches are not allowed. Those would include a death glitch and OoB glitches, other smaller glitches will be used in the run.
categories.name: any% No Major Glitches

games.description: Ultima 8 is a DOS-RPG from 1994 and was not very popular with Ultima fans, probably because it is a bit lighter on the RPG elements and instead has (kinda janky) platforming. The speedrun is almost a pacifist run and does a lot of stuff out of order or skips it completely with cool tricks like using blankets to cross a lava river and abusing the magic spells available.
games.name: Ultima VIII: Pagan

categories.description: any% allows warps, both intended hidden warps and unintended game over warps, so several stages of the game will be skipped.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Plok is a rather obscure and underrated Platformer where you shoot your limbs out to fight fleas. Involves challenging platforming, some cool boss fights and a few gimmicky vehicles to control. Also has an absolutely amazing soundtrack by the Follin brothers.
games.name: Plok

categories.description: only category, no restrictions
categories.name: any%

games.description: Skyblazer is a hidden gem on the SNES, a really solid platformer with good controls and fun boss fights. You gain magic spells including an air dash that is used a lot in the run. Speedrun tech includes zips and drop manipulations to refill magic for more dash usage. The game also has a few autoscrollers which would be perfect for donations or other announcements.
games.name: Skyblazer

categories.description:
Out-of-Bounds tricks are banned.
Other glitches are allowed which includes using intentional deaths to skip the intro stage and one of the intermissions completely.
categories.name: No OoB

games.description: VVVVVV is a very fast paced retro style precision platformer with the twist that instead of jumping you reverse the gravity of your character Viridian. It features a small open map that lets you choose levels in different orders. Each of the levels basically has a different gimmick that defines the stage, the final stage then combines them all. Also a great 8bit soundtrack.
games.name: VVVVVV

categories.description: only category, no restrictions
categories.name: any%

games.description: This is a really good Platformer that is widely unknown because it was only released in Japan. You play as a princess and fight demons to save your kingdom (or something like that). Movement features sliding and a little Pogo, you also get several magic spells to traverse the levels and fight bosses. One spell will be skipped with a very interesting camera glitch and bosses get manipulated with precise movement and attacks.
games.name: Magical Pop'n

categories.description: Nightmare mode has a completely different final stage and final boss compared to the other categories and also starts you with 3 characters instead of one which leads to a lot of unique strats, especially the first three stages have a lot of additional zips that would not be possible otherwise.
categories.name: any% Nightmare/Veteran

games.description: Curse of the Moon is a retro-style game from 2018, heavily inspired by classic Castlevania games, basically a spiritual successor to Castlevania 3 with great retro style graphics and an amazing soundtrack. It has been at ESA before but never Nightmare mode. The run involves a lot of Zips to skip parts of the stages and cool boss quick kills.
games.name: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon

categories.description: The most iconic episode of the Sly series, done like never before. Foil Dimitri's counterfeiting plans and retrieve the Clockwerk Tail Feathers by going through a barrage of missions and heists, and some pretty major skips to go alongside the movement emphasis the cutscene-skipper allows for.
categories.name: Episode 1: Any%

categories.description: You've seen Episode 6 at Winter 22, now get ready for Canada's second episode. This episode has had some of the game's best movement, but was previously totally overshadowed by long cutscenes. 100% requires getting 30 clue bottles, not much of a detour from Any% and incorporates more slick movement.
categories.name: Episode 7: 100%

games.description: The second instalment of the beloved Sly series, with a fresh twist! The 2024 re-release of the game features an interesting oversight on version 1.00, fully skippable cutscenes with the Start button. This changes the cozy-paced run to one with an emphasis on tight movement and traversal through all the jobs of the game; no pitstops, just go and retrieve all the Clockwerk Parts! Cutscene skips save about 80-90 minutes across the full game and saves 8-15 minutes in the categories submitted.
games.name: Sly 2: Band of Thieves

categories.description: This game has four minigames and all of them have a bunch of awards for doing neat things. Some of those range from "defend yourself for long enough" to "destroy 100 goddamn enemies". The run goes through all minigames and collects every bonus award from a fresh save file.

games.description: Did you know that in 2013, Coca-Cola has a partnership with PlayStation in Europe? The result of that is an obscure mobile game called Coca-Cola Zero PlayStation All-Stars Island. By scanning cans and bottles of Coke Zero with Nathan Drake on it, you can unlock endless-runner minigames of... quality? Believe me, there are PlayStation characters in this game, might be a bit hard to see over all the Coke Zero promotion though... Ever wanted to see Ratchet and Clank help Cole MacGrath? Now you can!
games.name: PlayStation All-Stars Island

categories.description: Since showcased three years ago, this category has changed immensely, but it hasn't lost it's contant fast paced action. We also have a new mod for this game, allowing us to do all the cool PS2 exclusive movement while enjoying faster load times and lag free gameplay on PS3
categories.name: NG+ (No IMG)

categories.description: Starting with nothing, you need to collect all 40 of the game's Platinum Bolts collectable. Truly the best showcase of everything the game has to offer in a run no longer than 70 minutes. Would also be a great way to show off the game's new movement mod which combines the best of PS2 and PS3
categories.name: All Platinum Bolts

games.description: Going Commando is a showcase of everything great about the R&C series and leaves no doubt as to why the series is alive to this day. This game has such a rich history rivalling the most popular games in speedrunning. Depending on the length of category being showcased you will either see how fast-paced the game is from start to finish or how the intensity can ramp up as you progress, collecting all the items you need to go fast.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando

categories.description: A unique category with an entirely different playstyle. Normally you need to free the dragons and collect gems in the game to complete it but we use a cheatcode to bypass those requirements and instead our goal is now to enter every vortex instead.
categories.name: Vortex

games.description: This game follows Spyro, a dragon whose kind is being frozen by an Orc called Gnasty. Throughout the game we go through six homeworlds each containing their own themes and levels. Our goal is to free all of the dragons and confront Gnasty.
games.name: Spyro The Dragon

categories.description: No QE stands for "No Quit Exploit" which bans a trick allowing most of the game to be skipped. In this run we play almost every level outside of a few. Some new additions to the route that has allowed us to save more than 6 minutes is the introduction of trophy strats and boxxys.
categories.name: NG+ NO QE

categories.description: This allows a trick called quit exploit where we can purchase an item that you normally recieve in a later level to skip almost the entire game making it a very short run.  It plays out very similar to NO QE however most of the middle part of the run is skipped.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: The end of the original trilogy of ratchet games, up your arsenal follows Ratchet as he tries to stop Dr. Nefarious from turning everyone into robots. This is also the first appearance of Dr. Nefarious in the series. It is mostly movement based and is always impressive to watch as its route has been ever evolving and is more different than ever before.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Up Your Arsenal

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible!
categories.name: Any% 2nd Quest

games.description:
Micro Mages was released in 2019 for the NES, an incredible fun and exciting platformer! In 2022 they did something unpresedented, they released a DLC for their game! The 2nd quest!
I currently have the fastest known time at 20:20 and would like to showcase the speedrun and talk about how this game was made and only use 40kb!

If the "donation goal" is reached I can arrange a 4 player co-op run instead of the original run. I've done trial runs and I am sure we can beat the game under 35 minutes!
games.name: Micro Mages 2nd Quest

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible!
categories.name: 2P Any%

games.description: Another new NES game, released in 2024! This is a top view shoot em up game where you utilize your ammunition and positioning to speed up the 20 levels!
games.name: Data Man

categories.description: Beat people up and advance screen til victory.
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: Hello yes, I am a ramen superhero from the UFO ramen noodle brand, I am using my beat em up skills to defeat men in shady tuxedos, clowns, pie throwing men, various bosses and the evil Kettler who is trying to steal my bride to be. I have an unicycle of death power I can use on occasion when it is spawned, and also my soy sauce gun  and popcorn screen bomb, arigato for your patience reading this.
games.name: UFO Kamen Yakisoban: Kettler No Kuroi Inbo

categories.description: Out of bounds glitched used a lot, a lot of unintended glitches also exist as the game is nonsense
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Take a lovely stroll through ye olde England streets and towns as Dr. Jekyll slowly tries to make his way to his wedding. On his way he will be attacked by bird poop, dogs, cats, gravediggers, slingshot boys, random bomb setting men, villagers and nearly everything in existence. If Jekyll is hit too much he turns into Mr Hyde who has to fire the PSYCHO WAVE to defeat brains and other ghouls to become Jekyll again.
games.name: Dr. Jekyll and Mr Hyde

categories.description: I will reset between stages to speedup getting to the next stages, must finish all trainers and missions and obtain the ending.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A famous launch title for the super famicom and snes, this game started the Pilotwings series and MODE 7. There are 4 different types of activities you can do on the trainer stages depending on the stage, and 2 helicopter missions. On most of the trainer stages there are extremely difficult bonus platforms to land on, landing on this speeds the run up and allows you to skip other stages since a points quota is required for each licence. This is a run full of many sweats and heart attacks.
games.name: Pilotwings

categories.description: Get to the end with the fastest route using Redwin as our character.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Now, this is a story all about how , my life got flipped-turned upside down. Start sippin champagne on a cruise ship, heard a rumble when the guests took a dip. We play as a hero tasked to ignore all possible survivors and get ourselves out of a sinking capsized cruise vessel. By way of exploding boiler rooms, random falling chairs and many pits to fall in, its a dangerous journey to the top. At the end of the trip, we can tell the rescuers we tried to save everyone, even though we didn't.
games.name: SOS

categories.description: Death abuse is used in some spots to restock special screen bombs and charges, no glitches can be found in the run to my benefit.
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: A game that was initially meant to be released in the 90's, was released in the amazing futuristic year of 2013 on the super nintendo! This is a run and gun game in a nightmare filled world as you play as a leprechaun. The run is practically Contra 3 meets fantasy as there is a lot of enemies, projectiles and pitfalls to stop your progress. I have the best time in all categories, but this category is the most entertaining and fastest
games.name: Nightmare Busters

categories.description: Finish the game as fast as possible using whatever means you can, and we have plenty of glitches and tricks to do so! Timing begins when you select difficulty. Timing ends when the final cutscene begins at the end of the Monster Ock chase. I am the current WR holder for this category.
categories.name: Any% (Easy)

games.description: Spider-Man (2000) has you play as the web-slinger in a story that sounds like it's been pulled straight from a classic comic book run. The speedrun showcases a great mix of both movement tech and glitches/OOB tricks made possible thanks to Spider-Man's unique moveset with his webs and webswinging (and general game jankiness). The Dreamcast allows you to run the game at 60fps on a PAL copy, which is the only version of the game to do so. The DC version also has exclusive, run-legal costumes.
games.name: Spider-Man (2000)

categories.description: Finish the game as fast as possible using whatever means you can, and we have plenty of glitches and tricks to do so! Timing begins when you select difficulty. Timing ends when the final cutscene begins at the end of the Monster Ock chase.  I am the current WR holder for this category.
categories.name: Any% (Easy)

games.description: Spider-Man (2000) has you play as the web-slinger in a story that sounds like it's been pulled straight from a classic comic book run. The speedrun showcases a great mix of both movement tech and glitches/OOB tricks made possible thanks to Spider-Man's unique moveset with his webs and webswinging (and general game jankiness). The PlayStation is the most popular platform for speedrunning this game, played on the PS2 to reduce load times. There are 3 costume options available to choose between.
games.name: Spider-Man (2000)

categories.description: Finish the game as fast as possible using whatever means you can, and we have plenty of glitches and tricks to do so!  Timing begins when you select difficulty. Timing ends on the blue fade out after Hyper-Electro is defeated.
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: The sequel to Spider-Man (2000) sees our hero in another adventure, this time trying to stop Electro from becoming the most powerful being on Earth! The speedrun showcases a great mix of both movement tech and glitches made possible thanks to Spider-Man's unique moveset with his webs and webswinging, some of which you don't ever see in the first game. Played on the PS2 to reduce load times.
games.name: Spider-Man 2: Enter Electro

categories.description:
From a Fresh File, obtain the following and beat the Game:
°All Platinum Bolts
°All Skill Points
°All Weapon Mods
°All Weapons at the Maximum possible Level
°The Carbonox Armor
°The Clank Zapper
°All Items that carry between Playthroughs
categories.name: Max%

categories.description: This has not been featured here before but this is similar to NG+ (No IMG), but instead of just rushing to the End, you finish every MIssion on the Mission Screen that you can finish.
categories.name: NG+ All Missions

categories.description: Similar to its NG+ Counterpart you finish EVERY Mission, but here you Start from a fresh File.
categories.name: Any% All Missions

games.description: The Sequel to the Game from 2002, this Will be Played on the Playstation 3 Console and there was  a Mod created for this Game that lets us enjoy the PS2 Movement on PS3 since they patched it on certain Versions of the Game.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando

categories.description:
Incentives: 
- Get all collectibles in 2nd auto-scroller (no time added)
- Read intro and outro poems in posh voice (see last minute for example, adds about 2 minutes total)
categories.name: Any% (Easy)

games.description: A 2D indie action platformer where you can alter each stage by switching between seasons, making water freeze or mushrooms grow to get through the stages, while wielding your magic melee crossbow to shoot or slash enemies that are in your way. The dev intended to make it look like a legitimate SNES game, with only the audio not keeping within the retro specs. Goal of the game is to collect at least 24 Magical Seeds to unlock all stages and then beat all bosses.
games.name: FOX n FORESTS

categories.description: Finish the game with the V-sync option turned off. That allows us to skip a total of five obstacles during the run that we would have to solve the intended way otherwise. And that is obviously kinda boring. Estimate allows for repeating one bossfight after dying to the last phase, not that I plan to
categories.name: Any% (V-sync off)

games.description: An action adventure set in the Dragons universe, but unrelated to the movies. Free enslaved dragons from their shackles together with your rapidly growing dragon partner. Harness the powers of ice, lightning and fire to solve puzzles. And cheese bosses as much as humanly possible.
games.name: DreamWorks Dragons Dawn of New Riders

categories.description: In the any% category we start from a fresh file so we have no abilities unlocked. The main tech is launching Raz horizontally fast by slamming into the ground and an infinite flying glitch. The back half of the game can be skipped entirely taking us to the end making it an interesting run.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: In this game you play as a boy named Raz who runs away from home to sneak into a super secret psychic training camp. The games levels are composed of Raz going into his teachers minds for training to become a psychic. This leads to a revelation that someone is stealing all the campers brains and Raz has to figure out who. The game itself is an OG 3D platformer. The levels are very creative and silly. The movement itself is very fast and there are lots of movement tech.
games.name: Psychonauts

categories.description: This category starts from a fresh file but with one special difference from normal any%. We can use assist features and these are invincibility, no fall damage, and narrative combat which is dealing double damage. This makes the run way more about the tech and tricks over more boring combat.
categories.name: Any% w/Assist

games.description: Psychonauts 2 is about a young boy with supernatural abilities named Raz who is an intern for a secret spy organization called the psychonauts. The game follows a mystery of an individual trying to infiltrate the organization. The game features one huge glitch allowing you to fly on objects in the world completing entire levels very quickly and skipping large sections. There are also many movement glitches to propel Raz forward. Since we are using assist features combat is also very quick.
games.name: Psychonauts 2

categories.description: This run is on a new game plus save which means the game has already been completed and we have all weapons at max level. We also are able to use some of the skill point challenge extras. This makes combat very fast and almost non existent focusing on the tricks and out of bounds areas.
categories.name: NG+

games.description: This game is the predecessor to Rift Apart which is the newest Ratchet game. This game follows a side adventure where Ratchet must stop a criminal who has escaped prison named Vendra. Her goal is to steal the Dimensinator, a dangerous device able to open portals to other dimensions. This is a very short run and features only 6 levels. This game does not have much movement glitches but tons of out of bounds and clipping through walls making it a marvel to watch.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Into The Nexus

categories.description: All glitches are allowed. In this run worlds 1,2 and 4 can be completely skipped using a glitch called a super jump to access the boss trigger right away in each of these worlds. Proxies which launch sly high in the air are also used. In addition there are lots of out of bounds strats.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Its time to steal back Sly's family legacy !! After Sly was left orphaned due to a group known as the fiendish five who stole his families book of secrets. Sly working with his two partners travel to 5 different main worlds to steal back the pages of the book. The run features massive world skips and crazy skips in every level of the run primarily out of bounds and catapults.
games.name: Sly Cooper and the Thievius Raccoonus

categories.description: In no lc coop 2 players have to cooperate to complete the game from an NG+ file, load cancelling is banned.  This category requires a lot of coordination and knowledge of the game from both players as not only they have to prove their worth in combat but also traverse the levels as fast as possible.
categories.name: NG+ No LC Co-Op

categories.description: In no lc coop 2 players have to cooperate to complete the game from an NG+ file, load cancelling is banned.  This category requires a lot of coordination and knowledge of the game from both players as not only they have to prove their worth in combat but also traverse the levels as fast as possible.
categories.name: NG+ No LC Coop

categories.description: In NG+ no LC you complete every mission in the game from an NG+ file . You will need the help of your 2 loyal bot companions and quick reflexes to navigate through the level and clean the waves of enemies as fast as possible
categories.name: NG+ No LC

games.description: Ratchet: Deadlocked is the 4th game in the Ratchet and Clank series. Its main focus is combat, but that doesnt mean it lacks the fast pace movement and the hardcore tricks the series is known for.  Fight waves of endless robots and infiltrate enemy bases with an entire arsenal of weapons, gadgets and mods at your disposal. Face the group known as "The exterminators" to set Ratchet and his friends free and shut down forever the illegal arena  fights happening in the Shadow Sector.
games.name: Ratchet: Deadlocked

categories.description: Any% is an incredible display of horizontal and vertical movement, using frame perfect tricks on almost every level that truly display the skill of the runner
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Last title of The Legend of Spyro series where Spyro and Cynder have to escape the evil Golem and finally beat the Dark Lord.
games.name: The Legend Of Spyro: Dawn Of The Dragon

categories.description: In ISM Any% is a very trick heavy category that relies on a lot of out of bounds, precise movement and the use of a trick called "level stacking" that allows the runner to play more than one level at the same time.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: In Sound Mind is a 2021 psychological horror game developed by We Create Stuff and published by Modus Games. Players control Desmond Wales, a psychiatrist who can enter alternate dimensions when listening to tape recordings of his clients. Each of Wales' clients has their own unique level based on their fears and psychoses.
games.name: In Sound Mind

categories.description: In this category you stack all the leftover side content in the game just like a burger. The challenges that you do are not included in any other category because the challenges are in fact optional and they dont cotribute to the completion of the game. In one level you also collect bacon.
categories.name: Burger King

games.description: Secret agent clank is a Ratchet and Clank spinoff where you sneak around as clank and complete a series of missions to save Ratchet and uncover a big mystery
games.name: Secret Agent Clank

categories.description: Beat the game on Easy difficulty. This is the fastest category.
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description:
Really cool side scrolling horror themed beat-em up game which is a part of the Simple 2000 game collection (STREET BOYYYYZ!) 
You slice through minions with two chainsaws, while managing fuel for bosses and specific waves of enemies. Seems pretty strait forward, but there are some small optimizations and tricks you can do throughout the run that safes some time. The game if very silly and have some goofy moments as Simple 2000 games tend to have.
games.name: Splatter Master

categories.description:
In this category we write all 80 Kanji from the official beginner pool called N5. The runner with the lowest mistakes count wins, if under estimate. Over estimate runners will be disqualified.
High energy commentary included!
categories.name: N5, Low mistakes%, random order, medium strictness

categories.description:
If nobody wants to race, I can also show the app on my own. :)
I will take my time and see if I can do every stroke perfectly. This would also include guessing the translations from only the readings of a kanji.
categories.name: N5, perfect score, random order, medium strictness

games.description:
Kanji Study is an Android App for practicing Japanese Kanji (that complex alphabet with thousands of characters). It has multiple learning modes, but we will show the one where you write the Kanji on your screen to check if you remember the stroke order correctly and do the strokes right. It's a lot of fun and I learned many Kanji this way!
The runners will have to be careful since the stroke detection can be quite harsh on certain strokes and it's not allowed to use the "ignore mistake"-button!
games.name: Kanji Study (Android App)

categories.description: In classic hard there's a lot going on, but jumping in the air like in any% is not allowed and also all cutscenes that we can't skip will be shown at full length. Since a way to cancel fall damage was discovered only 3 years ago, the run can still be finished in less than 90 minutes.
categories.name: Classic Hard

categories.description:
A race of the categories! Classic hard has cutscenes, so we've got time for another speedrun in the meantime! ;D
While the cutscenes in Classic play, we'll be running any%. As soon as a cutscene concludes, we gotta keep going in Classic. Both categories will be run by me alternatingly.
categories.name: Zandra's Challenge

games.description:
Oni is an action game from 2001. It has a wide variety of movement, fighting and shooting techniques which made it unique at its time. Last ESA summer I showed the any% category. Now I practiced the Classic Hard category a lot and improved my time, so I'm feeling confident showing this at ESA as well. :)
I have a lot to talk about for this game. If I find the time, I'll change the video links later, so there's commentary as well.
games.name: Oni

categories.description: Easy All Missions requires players to start every mission in the game in order. How players complete each mission is up to them and full level skips are allowed so long as you start every mission. This is also the "tank gun" category which allows players to grab an easter egg weapon for combat.
categories.name: Easy All Mission

games.description: Halo Infinite is a very movement focused game which allows players to use its grapple hook to move at fast speeds and interesting out of bounds mechanics which we use to circumvent the games levels. The grapple hook allows the player to reach high speeds for movement and makes it very interesting to watch from an audience perspective.
games.name: Halo Infinite

categories.description: The game has had an active few years with new glitches being found a little too often for my liking. Any% was accepted in 2022 but has very new tech to show off since then, changing a lot of routing and showing off really well just how broken this game has become
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Dishonored is a first person stealth immersive sim game made by Arkane Studios. It's signature ability Blink has the player teleport a short distance, allowing for extremely fast paced movement with quite a few glitches that allow the movement to be pushed even further.
games.name: Dishonored

categories.description: 2 Player Any% relies on the speed stacking glitch to make one player a super human running machine that can teleport, the other player is also present. They have to coordinate and divide tasks on the fly as the game has several random missions that can play out in very different ways.
categories.name: 2 Player Any%
