games.description: Redfall is the biggest letdown from Arkane studios ever from a casual point of view, its similar to left4dead, but has vampires. The game has changed quite a bit since last it was at ESA. The speedrun has enough unique twists and turns to make for an exciting run with several intense sections and has the two runners play very different roles that interplay very well, and has enough randomness to keep things fresh on the fly.
games.name: Redfall

categories.description: Last year we ran a 17 person tournament in the practice rooms at ESA, it was a blast, with stupid commentary and a lot more hype than we expected. This could be prime stream 2 content for a couple hours. We have content ideas for explaining the game to viewers at the start. discord DMs are open
categories.name: 16 player tournament

games.description: Sewer rave is an indie exploration game by Autumn Rain that has a lot of humor and goofy ideas thrown in. None of that is really relevant to the speedrun tho, seeing as it is straight gambling, every load door brings you to a random location, with some item randomization as well.
games.name: Sewer Rave

categories.description: Everything except for the big Stablaunch glitch is allowed
categories.name: Any% - NoStablaunch

categories.description: Mostly same as Any% but comes with 3 additions missions that we never get to see in the any% runs.
categories.name: All Levels - NoStablaunch

games.description: Built on a heavily modified Quake3 engine, Jedi Academy not only offers bunnyhopping and airstrafing but also comes with several unique movement mechanics that really make it stand out. In addition to the movement tech there is a plethora of amazing tricks the community was able to work out over the years that are just as flashy as they are difficult. Anything from OOB skips, broken vehicle mechanics, AI manipulation, broken Force Powers, engine quirks, etc. you name it.
games.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy

categories.description: An any% run of the game on 1 PC with myself and Baratdatwarat on one peripheral each, while showcasing some of the hardest tricks the game has to offer.
categories.name: Any% (2 Players 1KB+M)

categories.description: An any% race through all 10 chapters of the game between myself and Baratdatwarat. We are both players of a similar skill level.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: A 5v5 relay race by Team Juan and Team Carlos. Players will take 2 levels each. A good donation incentive that has worked in the past is Commentary Bias, see submission video for an example.
categories.name: Any% (Relay Race)

games.description: Fast-paced cult-classic 2008 parkour platformer with an unbeatable atmosphere.  The game contains a lot of satisfying and complex speedtech - such as the Sidejump and Kickglitch which are exploited frequently and make for a very entertaining run!
games.name: Mirror's Edge

categories.description: Beat the game, anything goes.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Classic 90's shooter, probably most famous nowadays for birthing the Unreal Engine, with an great atmosphere for a 90's game and fun gunplay. The run contains a lot of cool looking movement speedtech such as Dodging for general traversal and Bhops to conserve momentum, as well as ways to break the game completely and skip whole maps such as Save Hovering and Death Clipping.
games.name: Unreal

categories.description: Video example showcases last years Flash Game Gauntlet. It did very well and raised over 800$ from start to finish!
categories.name: Any%?

games.description: 20+ Flash Games done in roughly 1 hour and 20 minutes. Just like last year! List of games still being finalized :)
games.name: Flash Game Gauntlet 2

categories.description: Beat 7 different bosses with 7 different characters. Rules are added to help minimize resetting/RNG.
categories.name: R+7 (Season 3)

games.description: Rogue Like top-down shooter where you beat bosses/ pick up items to power-up your character.
games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance

categories.description: This is the Any% Category, :)
categories.name: Crowd Wins For Charity%

games.description: It's time again! I'm offering the best interactive game for everyone at ESA to be part of, The Price is Right! Complete with fun, random games, and the incentive to be good, this game will provide onsite fun for those attending and playing! I personally would love for a potential game to be on site at ESA, but not just  day, but Thursday, Friday and Saturday during the event. Think of it as a 3 Part Special! Games won will donate to the cause with the biggest event being on Saturday!!
games.name: The Price is Right (ESA Style)

categories.description: It's the Any% Run
categories.name: Any%

games.description: So it's all about Abobo, but unfortunately, his little one has been taken from him. Knowing how rage ridden he is, he is determined to get him back, whether he has to tackle levels from Mario, Double Dragon, Balloon Fight, Zelda or more. Join me as we tackle Abobo all throughout the lands of Mario and fight to get his son back from the evil... Mac? Yep. that's how it goes here!
games.name: Abobo's Big Adventure

categories.description: It's 6 games all done in Any%
categories.name: Any%

games.description: We go through 6 of the short yet amazing handheld Sonic's in a mini-marathon. Sonic 1, 2, Chaos, Triple Trouble, Blast and the AMAZING Labyrinth. Sit back, relax and experience the Sonic Sextet!
games.name: The Sonic 6 (8-Bit Edition)

categories.description: It's the Randomizer performed Any% style!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: It's the Resident Evil 3 Randomizer, however, this is pure INSANITY as unlike previous years, we now as we randomize the enemies, the items AND worst, I'm sorry, best of all, the doors! This is a stepup from last year with a little more challenge involved and probably some note taking! HAHA. Combined with randomizes NPC Dialogue from 20+ RE Games, this should be an amazing watch in the event!
games.name: Resident Evil 3 Randomizer

categories.description: It's Any%
categories.name: Any%

games.description: It's Mega Man from over 50 years ago. That's right, its Mega Man Atari Demake. This is what happens when you put a classic game like Mega Man 2 with the graphics, music and the LOVE of the Atari 2600.... You get THIS, the masterpiece. Submitting this as any% because, well that's about the only category of this game, LOL
games.name: Mega Man 2 Atari Demake

categories.description: In this category, we grab every single emerald as intended!
categories.name: All Emeralds

games.description: Let's play pinball with Sonic..... Yep, its Spanbill, where we are still trying to take down Robotnik, but instead of your typical platforming levels, we're stuck in a pinball machine down to save the world! Let's show the world there is more than 1 level in this game!
games.name: Sonic Spinball

categories.description: It's the Any% run!
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This is the simplest game ever! Match the shapes to the holes and place em! It doesn't get much easier than this
games.name: Fisher Price Perfect Fit

categories.description: The goal of this category is to collect 102%, including all DK Coins, Krem Koins and visiting all Kong Members. This was already demonstrated at ESA Winter 2024, but I feel like DKC2 is always a great game to showcase.

All Stages is a misc category of DKC2 and has the goal to complete all the stages including the Lost World. It is a combination of the True Ending Category + the rest of Any%. It is quite unique and offers a challenging run.
categories.name: All Stages

games.description: Probably the most beloved game out of the series. DKC2 offers a great soundtrack, great viewer experience and a fast paced and quality speedrun. Mechanics are similiar to DKC1, but with more animal buddy movement and different type of glitches.
games.name: Donkey Kong Country 2

categories.description: The goal of Any% is to finish the full game as quickly as possible. We will use some minor glitches or sequence breaks to skip bigger parts of the story and enable us to route the metroidvania part more efficiently.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: As the category name is indicating the goal of 100% is to collect all possible items, seals and notes. The route hasn't changed since I showcased this, but I would say it is more optimized and offers a cool and watchable run.
Second Quest is a more unique category, where we demonstrate the second part of the game that normally opens up to a metroidvania. It includes cool movement and some minor sequence breaks.
categories.name: Second Quest

games.description: The Messenger is a love letter to Ninja Gaiden and platforming. It was developed in 2018 by Sabotage and offers a great retro soundtrack combined with beautiful pixel graphics in a modern environment.
games.name: The Messenger

categories.description: The goal of the All Stages category is to complete the game as quickly as possible while finishing every stage. Over the past few years, the route has evolved significantly, thanks to the discovery of new glitches like Bird Croc and Antics Blaster. This category is a fantastic showcase.
categories.name: All Stages

categories.description: The goal of the No Major Glitches (NMG) category is similar to All Stages, but with the key difference that most of the major glitches, such as Jumprolls and Super Jump Rolls (SJR), are not allowed. As a result, this category focuses more on precise movement and execution.
categories.name: No Major Glitches

categories.description: The goal of the No Major Skips (NMS) category is similar to both NMG and All Stages, but with an important restriction: we’re not allowed to skip any sections, including bonus barrels, warp barrels, and other in-game skips. This makes it one of the toughest and most movement-focused categories.
categories.name: No Major Skips

games.description:
Donkey Kong Country is one of the most beloved and iconic series on the Super Nintendo, known for its tight platforming, beautiful graphics, and catchy soundtrack. The game has several categories to choose from, including All Stages, No Major Glitches, RBO , No Major Skips, and more. Each category offers a unique challenge and showcases different aspects of the game.
Out of the trilogy, Donkey Kong Country 1 is often regarded as the most "broken" game due to its abundance of glitches.
games.name: Donkey Kong Country

categories.description: Completing every song that game has to offer on Bronze, Silver and Gold difficulty.
categories.name: All Songs

games.description:
Vib-Ribbon is a rhythm game in which players guide the main character, Vibri, across a line filled with obstacles tied in correspondence to the beat of the song. 
There are four basic obstacles; block, loop, wave, and pit, which require players to press the L, R, X, or Down buttons respectively at the right time to navigate.
The game's main gimmick was that any CD could be inserted and the game would create a stage off of it, essentially allowing for endless levels.
games.name: Vib-Ribbon

categories.description: The first two years of the game, finishing with the boss battle against Slymmer.
categories.name: Defeat Slymmer

games.description: A combination Myst-like and farming sim advertisement game for the Swedish dairy Arla, complete with a boss battle. Made for Windows 3.1. Quite jank.
games.name: Myulk: Kampen om det öppna landskapet

categories.description: Warpless contains all the stages without taking the rocket on first stage, meaning more talk about Nibbley Pibbleys and wonky tricks on certain stages.
categories.name: Warpless

games.description: You are playing as a snake and your goal is to eat these balls called "Nibbley Pibbleys", the goal on each stage is to eat as many Nibble Pibbleys till you get fat and can move on to the next stage, all the way up to the moon which is the goal of the game. Get the Snakes to Space!
games.name: Snake Rattle 'n' Roll

categories.description: 57 Gold Bars consists of beating all 19 levels in their easiest variation as fast as possible. In matches, we make use of the many gimmicks and power-ups to our advantage, but some levels can also be cheesed using AI manipulation.
categories.name: 57 Gold Bars

games.description: Pong: The Next Level (simply known as Pong in PAL regions) is a 3D remake of the 1972 classic arcade game Pong released in 1999 on PlayStation and PC. It features many different levels that are either traditional 1v1 matches or single player challenges, each level having their own unique power-ups and environmental gimmicks which drastically affect the gameplay.
games.name: Pong: The Next Level

categories.description: Beat the final boss. This is the most optimized of the main categories and new tricks are still being discovered and implemented. The run starts off a little slow, but as it progresses and more spells and abilities are made available, it gets more and more action packed.
categories.name: Kill Ranrok

games.description: One of the most popular games to come out in 2023. In this open world RPG set in the world of Harry Potter, we utilize a wide range of classic speedrunning techniques including movement exploits, NPC manip, menu glitches, XP duplication and cut-scene skips, as well as general combat and routing optimization.
games.name: Hogwarts Legacy

categories.description: Super fast paced 2D platformer where you use your giant laser as both a weapon AND a jet pack! Precise angles and clutch movement is the name of the game to get from the start of the game to the final boss.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Time is relative, the multiverse is real, and our evil self is trying to kill us! There's no time to explain so just follow me to... AAAARRGGGHHH! WHAT IS THAT???
games.name: No Time To Explain Remastered

categories.description: The campaign, but fast!
categories.name: Any% Recruit

categories.description: The Spec Ops mode, but fast! this is harder!
categories.name: Spec Ops

games.description: The best COD, once again.
games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009)

categories.description:
(currently working on a submission video)
This category allows Bhopping and also some scripts to do a few things faster. In general the coolest category in my opinion. Very underrated, nobody else runs it!
categories.name: Scripted w/ Bhop

games.description: This is just like Half Life, except it's CS 1.6!
games.name: Counter Strike: Condition Zero Deleted Scenes

categories.description: The 106% TE NMG category consists of completing the game while doing the entire content of the game (without the latest godhome DLC) and finishing with the True Ending in NMG (No Major Glitch). This is an interesting category that allows you to see the entire game finished very quickly.
categories.name: 106% TE NMG

categories.description: The All Bosses NMG category consists of defeating all the bosses in the game. This category allows you to take on complex and demanding bosses while being relatively lightly equipped, which gives an epic and complex end to the run.
categories.name: All Bosses Grimm Troupe NMG

categories.description: The True Ending category consists of completing the game with the true ending, which allows you to see many of the game's bosses and iconic locations in a reasonably short amount of time. This category remains very difficult with a climactic ending.
categories.name: True Ending NMG

categories.description: The All Skills category consists of finishing the game by collecting all the skills (offensive and movement spells) in the game and going to kill the last boss in NMG (No Major Glitch). This category highlights a certain number of demanding and impressive skips.
categories.name: All Skills NMG

games.description: A metroidvania released in 2017, Hollow Knight is an adventure and exploration game where you play a character in an insectoid world in which you travel through the fallen kingdom of Hallownest. This game has a lot of content and therefore many different speedruns varying greatly depending on the category. The game being quite demanding, the speedrun is just as much. Hollow Knight has managed to establish itself as a must-play game of recent years.
games.name: Hollow Knight

categories.description: The standard category where you start a run on the lowest difficulty and finish it as quickly as possible. An optimal run is faster than the estimate, but since this is a roguelike, we have to account for potentially dying. An incentive for this game could be a bid war to choose the character.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Peglin is roguelike where you play as one of four characters, using orbs as weapons to defeat enemies. The game plays like Slay The Spire, where you traverse through three different biomes, encountering events, relics, shops and bosses along the way. The goal of this run is to get as powerful a build as quickly as possible without fighting too many enemies, as event tiles tend to be faster than combat tiles.
games.name: Peglin

categories.description: In this category, the goal is to achieve victory four times in a row with all of the aspects of one of the game's weapons. A potential incentive or bid war for this run could be to choose the weapon used in the run. There aren't any major glitches in the run, we just play as fast as we can!
categories.name: OwO (One Weapon Only)

categories.description: The classic Hades Speedrun Category, here you must beat the final boss three times in a row with three different weapons, aiming to use the most powerful combinations to go as quickly as possible.
categories.name: 3 Weapons

games.description: Hades is a roguelike where you play as Zagreus, the son of the titular character. Your goal is to make your way out of the underworld as soon as possible, utilizing boons from the Greek Gods to empower you along the way.
games.name: Hades

categories.description: Bejeweled 3 has a game mode called "Quest Mode", where you complete a series of Quests to uncover hidden relics. This category requires us to 100% quest mode by completing all of the minigames, using various tech to help us complete the minigames more consistently.
categories.name: All Quests

categories.description: This is a category where you only complete 4 quests per relic to partly uncover them. This category is faster than All Quests, but has less variety as we tend to pick the fastest minigames, which are often very similar across relics.
categories.name: Quest Mode 50%

games.description: Bejeweled 3 is a Match-3 Game where you match Jewels to gain points. If you match more than 3 gems, you gain a special gem that clears more gems. For a really simple game, there's still a lot of fun tech involved!
games.name: Bejeweled 3

categories.description: In this category, we beat all of the minigames and boss fights in the game. A potential incentive for this could be to upgrade the run to Hard Mode, which increases the difficulty of the fights by requiring more inputs in the minigames and removing visual indicators for dodging in the boss fights.
categories.name: All Minigames and Bosses

categories.description: This is a showcase for different songs of the highest difficulty. The game has a total of 32 songs, with a plethora of different genres.  A potential donation incentive could be to do one or two songs in Shopkeeper Mode, where the shopkeeper sings like he does in Crypt of the Necrodancer.
categories.name: Song Showcase (Impossible Difficulty)

categories.description: A combination of the two submissions above, to fully show what the game has to offer.
categories.name: All Minigames & Bosses & Song Showcase on Impossible Mode

games.description: Rift of the Necrodancer is a rhythm game set in the Necrodancer universe where you play as Cadence, the protagonist of Crypt of the Necrodancer. Teleported to a different world, she has to beat familiar enemies to the rhythm of the music, with each enemy type having a pattern of their own. The game has a story mode, with minigames and boss fights and 4 separate difficulties. There is also the possibility for custom charts. Feel free to reach out with questions about the game and run!
games.name: Rift of the Necrodancer

categories.description:
Loony is used as his Bionic Arm charge attack is REALLY powerful & has extra wall splat damage too.
Difficulty differences is usually the number of enemies on screen per wave, base HP and their aggro speed.
categories.name: Loony Any%

games.description:
A new beat em up game that's out for NEO GEO but came out to modern platforms first.
You can play as either: 
Golem a robot with swift fists like a boxer, 
Loony a scientist with a BIONIC ARM or 
Candy an afro girl with killer blades.
The game has a mechanic designed for speedrunners where using a HP draining special against an enemy in the air as a juggle tool can deal twice the amount of damage
The devs have even given me a DEBUG build when I made an analysis video showcasing their moves.
games.name: Vengeance Hunters

categories.description:
Enemy randomiser will shuffle certain types of enemies with another of the same "tier".
So Galsia swapping with Donovan is okay but Galsia swapping with an end of level boss isn't.
The stages have been shuffled too to make me think on the spot on what to anticipate next.
HARD difficulty - Retro OST.
categories.name: Stage & Enemy randomiser run as SoR4 Shiva [HARD]

games.description:
Lizardcube's second project at reviving old SEGA IPs attract a new generation of players.  
The game has combos, many of them are out of this world.   
The character Shiva is a swift combo king as he is the only character to have a true aerial rave combo and a 3rd Strike-esque juggle that makes the audience wanna shout "AY" for each launch hit. There are 12 stages and 39 non-bonus maps altogether.
Fun fact: The default difficulty from the developers when producing this game is HARD not NORMAL.
games.name: Streets of Rage 4

categories.description: Momentum platformer, with a lot of quick weapon/skill swaps, and a point system that refreshes your "Skill usage" so you need to route that in as well. As you need to "menu" by pressing jump button and down, that creates a lot of quick inputs to maintin running speed during these swaps.
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: This girl has been terribly sunburned by her lab professor, so now she's running everywhere taking her anger out on anything she sees! [Might be emulated run, submiting as not emulated cause I hope someone can borrow me a console]
games.name: Psychic World

categories.description: In this categories we ignore our friends and escape on our own. Some tight health management and a really quick run
categories.name: Beat the game

categories.description: (Have no recorded run of this) In this category we rescue all cosmo chick, we get to explore some hidden passages and see more of the game.
categories.name: All Cosmo Chick

games.description: You are a spacegulls that flaps your wings, Imagine a controllable flappy bird! Navigate through mazes, kill enemies to unlock the path forward, fly through secret areas to find your friends and reach the end for a final battle.
games.name: Spacegulls

categories.description: Beating the game requires us to find the keys, to beat the only boss to access our double jump. With limited health pickups on route this can be a nail biter due to running low on health, and this being a 1 life game.
categories.name: Beat the game

categories.description: [No saved video for this run] In this run we collect all the crystals hidden in the castle. Doing this will require some glitched movement with the double jump.
categories.name: All Crystals

games.description: A girl get thrown into a dungeon in a castle, but she is more than a girl, she's a Wolfling. But touching moonlight you can turn into a wolf with new movement. Explore and escape the castle by utilizing both your humonoid and wolf form. A homebrew game from 2018, and one of the great metroidvanias created for the NES.
games.name: Wolfling

categories.description: We play as haggar that needs the most exp to reach max level, but also starts at the highest level. Dashes, infinitive combos and most important.... PILEDRIVING! A lot of rng to adjust to, quick kills on bosses, and always a fast pace in this category.
categories.name: Haggar

games.description: Final Fight for the NES is a cute beat em up game, with a level up system that affects how much damage you do, and new moves you can do. Play through 5 stages, beat up everyone, and rescue Haggar's daughter.
games.name: Mighty Final Fight

categories.description: Trying to not lose any race, trying to manipulate our opponent to not lose(cause this will spawn a fully upgraded opponent each time), and most important... Can I last mashing for the final race?
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: Racing game that are devided between two modes: Top down racing where you can collect power ups and money to use to upgrade your bigfoot for the 2nd part, the mashing part. Where you go 1vs1 with the cpu in a best of 3 race. You have to gear, and the mashing is done with... Dpad!? Yes press left and right as fast as possible, but also care for your engine to not overheat.
games.name: Bigfoot

categories.description: Perform despawns with help of birds, fight enemies that are way overtuned, and don't game over in the racing stages.
categories.name: Beat the game

categories.description: In the japanese version enemies are much easier, racing stages are easier, and as a bonus, there's a bad ending where you just ignore annebelle and she gets sad you don't wanna hug her.
categories.name: Mad City - Beat the game

games.description: You are Billy, and your sweetheart Annebelle got kidnapped by Gordon after you hurt his criminal activities. Fight you way through the Bayou, take down a helicopter with just a gun, drive at insane speeds, and rescue Annebelle.
games.name: Adventure of Bayou Billy

categories.description: Not only need we beat the game, but win it. Which forces us to keep mashing. I love this category, cause I get to talk about how mashing is a fun and interesting skill in speedrunning, and also talk about how I avoid hurting myself while mashing.
categories.name: Win the game

games.description: In this cycle game you cycle around the country of Japan. You need to mash to keep your speed up, avoid crashing not only the natual things, but other oppoenents. Have team mates give you power ups, earn money to buy upgraded bikes. But most important: Can you mash for 40 minutes? Just beating this game is an achievement.
games.name: Cycle Race: Road Man

categories.description: Getting through a run without taking a game over is really hard(but not punishing), quick kills on bosses, using your aura shield to deflect projectiles.
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: You are a 16 year old girl with a sword... This an anime so you can figure the rest out. Get through 5 stages, of intense platforming, sword action filled fighting! [Emu if I can't borrow a console]
games.name: Mamono hunter yohko

categories.description: In this category we ignore most of our friends and escape the circus... The game will even tell us we will never be happy ever again...
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: Rolo has been captured by the evil circus, so has his friends! Find your way to escape the evil circus in this platforming game with the help of your friends!
games.name: Rolo to the rescue

categories.description: In the japanese version we can pick easy mode. In easy mode we start levels with hearts, keep subweapon on death, and enemies have less health. And most important, no knockback on taking a hit. Because of all the changes, we could(most likely won't) one shot all bosses!
categories.name: Beat the game - Easy

games.description: It's Castlevania
games.name: Castlevania

categories.description: Getting through this game is a lot about not getting stuck, and using your money effective. People will yell at me for being blind, tell me they could play it better, which is part of the fun!
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: Homebrew game for the sega master system. Puzzle game where you choose your hero to perform battle against several demons. Get 3 in a row to unleash the effect, such as Slashing, throwing magic, guarding, bombing, using a potion or just collect money that can be used for level ups. [Hoping to borrow console, otherwise emulated]
games.name: Heroes Against Demons

categories.description: We jump on boats, go into sewers, light up a aligator, poison a panther, jump through a roof, and we hope our kick connects on the final boss(We will pick up shuriken for safety, unless people call me a wimp for doing that).
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: The Last Ninja is the second entry to the last ninja games, but the only one with a NES release. Some things were changed or removed to make it fit the NES experince more. Collect items to get through each stage, avoid enemies, get the safe password and knockdown the final ninja and light the five candles to beat this game!
games.name: The Last Ninja

categories.description: In this category we ignore all game mechanics basicly. We do the very first 2min of the game, to then head to a elevator... Elevators brakes this game, and luckily the most broken one is in the very first stage!
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: Struggle through RNG, collect almost all power ups, all swords, and have a mandatory donation reading segmet(A.K.A Grinding). Great music, cool bosses, and a really difficult game that very few people have seen a full run off.
categories.name: Beat the game(No wrong warp)

games.description: You are a space cop in the stage based metroidvania. You have skills to collect to be able to progress, you pick up many weapons that you can level up throughout the run, and even a exp system for you character as well!
games.name: Cosmo Police Galivan

categories.description: No cheats. Navigate through 80 levels + bosses. Memorizing all levels is really hard, but worth it cause of the rave in level 51.
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: You are a flea, that keeps jumping. You can adjust hight with the jump button, you can dash later in the game.  This game take place inside of a dog(I think?), escaping the natural hazard of the inside of it!
games.name: Flea!

categories.description: The reason I pick the J version is cause I feel it is very overlooked. The version adds more movement options being viable, such as the jump kick, makes the special move slightly easier to do, and just a more enjoyable experince in my opinion.
categories.name: Beat the game - Japanese

games.description: Everyone knows this game! Beat em up with the turtles, NES version had a few extra stages. Save April from shredder and take him down!
games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Arcade Game

categories.description: Collect enough money on first stage to get through the rest of the game by avoiding all money pick ups after it. Straight forward, and most of it comes down to RNG.
categories.name: Beat the game

categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: Your castle get shrunken and stolen by a evil wizard. Annoying bird lead you to a non evil wizard that tells you what to do. Collect items to progress through the game, like throwing a boot at a cat, or giving a bear a fish. This Konami port is janky, but still impressive for being on the nintendo.
games.name: King's Quest V

categories.description: Precise platforming, adjusting to enemy rng in beat em up sceenes, manipulations to get autoscrollers to end quicker.
categories.name: Beat the game

games.description: Anyone remember the tv-shot? No? Well doesn't matter cause the game has very little with it to do! 6 action packed stages, combining platformer with beat em up. Three teams to pick between, each based on a real person from the tv-show!
games.name: Rollergames

categories.description: Endy and I had a world record battle that resulted in a 10s improvement of the world record and tons of optimization. There's ton of frame tight tricks, some frame perfects, optimized movement, option for dangerous or safe strats depending on how the race is going.
categories.name: Any% (Best of 3)

games.description: You controll spike, and after Spike gives his teacher Dr. Ernest Femur a skull he had found at the cemetary the school gets over run by haunted creatures! Not only that, his crush, Samantha Pompom have been kidnapped!  Even the star fotball players could not rescue her... neither could Spirit Ridders Task Force with their special equipment, they or their equipment never returned from the school... So it is up to Spike to rescue Samantha!
games.name: Ghoul School

categories.description: This category takes you through the 17 events that take place between Episode III through Episode V. Travel through the betrayal of the Jedi in this thriller 17-part series
categories.name: RotE All Missions with bonuses

games.description: Star Wars Battlefront II is a beautiful game that has 20 different battlefronts, and includes categories like the Campaign, Galactic Conquest, and Instant Action. The Campaign takes you from events in Episode III to Episode V, and you can travel the galaxy in Galactic Conquest and Instant Action.
games.name: Star Wars Battlefront II (Classic 2005)

categories.description: KPDR, also called Old Route or Fun Route has for a long time taken a backseat to the more popular route of Any%; PRKD. Any% KPDR follows the "intended" boss order (Kraid, Phantoon, Draygon, Ridley.) Featuring fast bosses, sick movement and is quite marathon safe. This will be a race Gebbu vs Timmon_
categories.name: Any% KPDR

categories.description: Map Completion is one of the most interesting and diverse categories in Super Metroid speedrunning. With unique strategies and routes seen nowhere else as well as tight ammo routing, the category aims to complete the game while fully filling out the in-game map as fast as possible.
categories.name: 100% Map Completion

games.description: Super Metroid is as classic as it gets among speedgames and I think everyone who has dipped their toes in retro gaming speedruns is at least aware of the legacy of this game. I believe most speedrunners would agree that no marathon would be complete without some kind of Super Metroid showcase. I have personally been running this game for about 5 years now and I still can not get enough of its movement, boss fights, variety in categories and the endless potential to improve.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: KPDR, also called Old Route or Fun Route has for a long time taken a backseat to the more popular route of Any%; PRKD. Any% KPDR follows the "intended" boss order (Kraid, Phantoon, Draygon, Ridley.) Featuring fast bosses, sick movement and is quite marathon safe. This will be a race Gebbu vs Timmon_

games.description: Super Metroid is as classic as it gets among speedgames and I think everyone who has dipped their toes in retro gaming speedruns is at least aware of the legacy of this game. I believe most speedrunners would agree that no marathon would be complete without some kind of Super Metroid showcase. categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible with two players, coop. The run thrives with two jeeps dancing around the bullet hell and getting quicker cycles on the bosses.
categories.name: Any% (2 Player)

games.description: Fans of Contra flock to this overhead "run and gun" style game by Konami where the Jackal unit drives jeeps into hostile territory to rescue POWs and take down the enemy units. The music jams and the action is non-stop. YEAHHH!
games.name: Jackal

categories.description: Race of two players going head to head to see who gets to the moon fastest. Can also have teams of two players each, switching off between each race. The player on the side can help their teammate locate Waldo.
categories.name: Easy, Race (Best of 3)

games.description: The most "true to book" experience of finding Waldo (Wally). Bethesda's early development days were the peak with this game - randomizing Waldo's position so well that every attempt is a different. The pixels are barely enough to spot him. Where is he hiding?!
games.name: Where's Waldo

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible with two players, coop. Recently improved the WR with a new quick kill strat on the first boss and having fun grinding RNG. Clean and synchronized movement to abuse camera/screen scroll along with lag reduction and efficient special attack usage is key.
categories.name: Any% (Coop)

games.description: Step aside Captain Planet, this fast paced 2D action platformer that looks like Strider features two enhanced Cyborgs, Allen and Sheena, battling through a mutant threat stemmed from a chemical reaction trying to eradicate Earth's pollution.
games.name: Run Saber

categories.description: Beat the game as fast as possible with two players, coop. We choose Billy and Pimple to maximize jumps and attacks. Juggling bosses and the dynamite glitch are a few ways to help survive the onslaught.
categories.name: Co-op Any%

Poki skip, a sequence break that was only recently made RTA viable shows that the community of this 20+ year old game is still alive and evolving
categories.name: NG+

games.description: The first game in the beloved Ratchet and Clank series, featuring a touching story about friendship and responsibility. Anyway, in the speedrun, you're just a cat that wants to go fast. Preserving momentum is the name of the game, chaining together different movement tech and glitches. In most levels, the only objective is getting to the end as fast as possible, which results in clips, unexpected routes, and a couple of instances of out of bounds movement.
games.name: Ratchet and Clank (2002)

categories.description: The category completes the game's first cycle (NG). During the stages special challenges have to be completed to get upgrade materials in order to stay at a relevant power level, putting extra strain on the player.
categories.name: Any% NG

categories.description: This category completes the games 2nd cycle (NG+) from start to finish. Since giving the villager's jobs and commanding takes time, most of the stages will be handled solo, leading to hectic fights and strategic use of all of Soh's abilities.  In addition, NG+ features a "true" final boss.
categories.name: Any% NG+

games.description: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess is an action-strategy game developed and published by Capcom on July 19, 2024. The player assumes control of Soh, who is tasked to protect a divine maiden named Yoshiro who must purge/cleanse villages of defilement and defeat the Seethe to return the legendary Mt. Kafuku to peace.
games.name: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess

categories.description: This category aims to complete all of the game's main quests on the easiest difficulty setting ('Dawn'). Gameplay alternates between quickly navigating the open world to the next mission and then blitzing through those.
categories.name: Any% Dawn

games.description:
Embark on an epic journey across war-torn 19th-century Japan in this combat-focused open-world action RPG from Team NINJA, the veteran studio behind Nioh and NINJA GAIDEN.
Japan, 1863. After three centuries of the Tokugawa Shogunate’s reign, the Black Ships of the West descend upon the nation’s borders and the country falls into a state of turmoil. Amidst the chaos of war, disease and political unrest, a nameless warrior forges their own path, holding the very fate of Japan in their hands.
games.name: Rise of the Ronin

categories.description: This is the "bad ending"-category of TLF - which also happens to be the fastest ending - played on the most recent patch. Since MOST glitches have been patched out, fast clears rely on optimal movement and skill against the various bosses.
categories.name: Any% 1.5.2 Hail to the King

games.description: 'Bloodborne goes Metroidvania' in this 2D pixelgraphic indie horror game. Step into The Last Faith’s ravaged world as Eryk, who awakens with no recollection of his immediate past. Soon he will discover he is in a race against time as his mind and conscience begins to deteriorate. His desire for salvation from this affliction sets him on a cursed mission that crosses paths with ancient religions and divinities.
games.name: The Last Faith

categories.description: This category completes all of the main games main story missions. The use of the DLC items and abilities is allowed, speeding up certain sections compared to a "standard" run.
categories.name: Any% NG+ Lethal with DLC

categories.description: This category basically combines the "Any% NG+ Lethal With DLC" and "Iki Island NG+" categories.
categories.name: Two Islands NG+

games.description:
Ghost of Tsushima is an open-world Action-Adventure, tasking the player with liberating the island of Tsushima from invading Mongol Forces. It was developed by SuckerPunch Productions (known for the Sly Cooper and inFamous series) and released in July of 2020. A Director's Cut of the game was released in August 2021, which includes a whole new island to explore as well as various new skills and other items.
With the release of the 'sequel' on the horizon, what better time to showcase this?
games.name: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut

categories.description: The Any% category follows the game *mostly* along its intended path, with one big skip in the 4th area. Boss fights start out rather easy, but get quite challening towards the end as the player's power level starts to plateau.
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: Ever wondered what 'Devil May Cry' would look like if it turned into a 2D action-platformer? Well, wonder no longer as 'TDW: Satgat' will show you exactly that!
games.name: The Devil Within: Satgat

categories.description:
Memes.
The unskippable cutscene with the corn is funny, I guess?
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This game is - without a doubt - absolute garbage. Highly unoptimized for a PC "port", this will most likely make every PC it's run on crash and burn for no reason at all.
games.name: Hotdog Samurai

categories.description: This category aims to complete the game from a fresh save file as quickly as possible.  The difficulty lies in optimizing the mandatory fights as much as possible, as things can go wrong rapidly.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Like a Dragon: Ishin! is a standalone spinoff of the Like a Dragon series set in 1860s Japan during the Bakumatsu Era at the end of the Edo Period. Japan is thrown into turmoil after the arrival of Western ships, galvanizing the imperialist ideals of the Shishi, who wish to rebuild the nation around the Emperor by overthrowing the Bakufu and expelling foreigners.
games.name: Like a Dragon: Ishin!

categories.description: The triple jump, a central glitch in all skips, makes this run extremely dense and varied, between combat optimization, bosses, and OOB setup. A donation goal can be placed to have the Low% category instead, changing nothing in the estimate.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: In this run, you must find the 24 memories scattered in the different timelines of the game. Also called the 100% of version 1.02, this is the most complete glitched category.
categories.name: All Memories

games.description: Omensight is a 3D adventure game where we embody "the Harbinger", a light entity capable of going back in time. Thus, we relive the same day in a loop in order to prevent Voden, the avatar of the Void, from destroying the world. The Omensight speedrun requires a number of battles in enemy-filled rooms as well as against bosses. But also to master many skips and OOB made possible via several glitchs present in the game.
games.name: Omensight

categories.description: The objective of this run is to win a game alone against 5 bots on maximum difficulty. There are many strategies, but I think the most interesting one to show in a marathon is to use Tryndamere, the Berzeker. Forcing the runner to be playing on the edge of death, this will provide the best show.
categories.name: 1v5 Bots

games.description: Much better known as an immovable pillar of esports, League of Legends also has its SRC page. It's a MOBA. The objective is to destroy the main building of the opposing team: the Nexus. Many challenges have been theorized in Summoner's Rift, including one of the most obvious: how quickly can we destroy the Nexus, alone against 5?
games.name: League of Legends

categories.description: The most famous and competitive Pokémon speedrun : THE RED RUN. Any% Glitchless, despite its title, includes a large amount of techniques. Let us quote the Red Bar strat, allowing to accelerate the fights. IT strat, to speed up dialogues. And of course the RNG Manip, taking advantage of hard resets.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description: Pokémon Red and Blue version, one of the most famous games in the world where you play as a trainer in his quest to become a Pokémon Champion. As in many turn-based RPGs, the speedrun in this game is filled with randomness. But thanks to the accumulated experience of speedrunners through the ages and the discovery of RNG Manipulation, Pokémon Red has become a rather stable and very competitive speedrun!
games.name: Pokémon Red

categories.description: On "Furier" difficulty, all the bosses are much stronger and the 2 bosses of the DLC must also be faced. In doing so, it is the most difficult category possible on Furi.
categories.name: Speedrun Mode (Furier)

games.description: Furi is a game mixing action and shoot 'em up. The action range is composed of a dodge, a parry and two types of attacks. The game does not offer progression trees, abilities, or unlocking weapons. It requires only skills. We play Raider, a mysterious warrior who tries to escape from a gigantic prison held by 9 guards. So : it is a boss rush. I play this game on PC, keyboard and mouse.
games.name: Furi

categories.description: The flagship category of the game. The most used "trick" of the run is undoubtedly death abuse, allowing you to skip cutscenes or even reset the location of certain enemies.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This game is a Die & Retry based on Metal Slug gameplay. We embody the young Rise who, armed with Shine, his strange revolver, must save Gamearth from the invasion of the "Next Gen"! A graphically beautiful game, full of easter eggs. It is a very demanding speedrun in terms of execution. A single mistake means death, coupled with a painful waste of time.
games.name: Rise & Shine

categories.description: In Journey Mode, we're "Traveling" through many different Styles of Music (?) and get immersed with their Visuals and Effects. There are a total of 27 different Style shown, and our Goal is to get through all of them without Topping out.
categories.name: Journey Mode - Normal

games.description: Tetris Effect is a more Immersive, Audio and Visual Appealing Version of your Classic Blockstacking Game. Throwing many Different Styles at you, in various Game Modes, either Singleplayer or Multiplayer. Choose your Style and get immersed by the Game.
games.name: Tetris Effect Connected

categories.description: The True Pacifist Ending is seen as the ultimate way to beat the game. This run requires me to spare all bosses in interesting ways that you may have never seen, as well as showcasing the funny moments that the game has to offer (such as dating a skeleton).
categories.name: True Pacifist Ending Glitchless

games.description: Undertale is an indie game developed by Toby Fox, where the main mechanic is choosing whether to kill or not kill the monsters. Each monster you kill affects the ending that you receive. The run requires that you fight 6 bosses, and you undergo certain actions to unlock the true pacifist ending. It also requires item management and transversing the game without dying.
games.name: Undertale

categories.description:
- Fastest known way of finishing the original game.
- New massive extremely complicated and hard skip from 2024 that skips 1.5 hours of the past run
- Going into CD2 underleveled and underressourced.
- New creative boss strategies, steproute, money route and experience route developed for the run
categories.name: any%

games.description: FF7 is a turn based RPG and a legendary one at that. The run generally features real time fast paced turn based combat, fast menus, glitches, skips, tight movement with steproute, money, kill/experience route, some RNG manipulations and optimized fights.
games.name: Final Fantasy VII

categories.description: Category simply consists of completing the game normally. To unlock the story triggers you need to collect treasures to increase your vault value, which will also unlocks boss fights that gives you hints to find the 7 seven stones, mandatory treasure to unlock the final bosses.
categories.name: any%

games.description:
A very particular Dragon Quest game ! In this spin-off, no turn based battle, it is in real time ! Your main weapon is a slingshot, which can throw a ton of different pellets to adapt on the different weaknesses of the enemies. You can also scout monsters so they join your journey and help you to find treasures !
This run is sadly very RNG heavy : everything about the treasures is random, monster behaviour is very inconsistant, and
games.name: Dragon Quest Treasures

categories.description: After showing the True Ending run 2 years ago, I thought it would be nice to show a different category. Since any% is a part of the True Ending run, I decided to submit any% glitchless. In this category you only stay on 3D mode to just rush all the story without any big XP grind.
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description: Most recent game of the main serie, Dragon Quest XI S has a good amount of features that makes it very enjoyable to run and watch. This includes cutscene skip, very fast battle animations, no random encounters, very versatile  skill system...
games.name: Dragon Quest XI S

categories.description:
The run abuses of the synthesis to unlock strong monsters and particularly strong spells to snowball and stomp the mid game, after a difficult early game.
The game is gift a few bonus balls at the very beginning that we can use to increase our XP gains, making possible to rush without grinding XP.
categories.name: any%

games.description:
After the success of Dragon Quest Monster Joker 1 & 2 outside japan (3 only came out in jp), Dragon Quest Monsters 3 is the most recent Monster spin-off released around the world! It tells the story of Psaro, the vilain of Dragon Quest IV, who became a monster wrangler to rule on Nadiria.
In this game you will control up to 4 monsters in battle, that you can either scout in different biomes or synthesis together to create even more powerful monsters.
It has Cutscene skip & fast battle animation
games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters 3: The Dark Prince

categories.description: This is the any% run of the game which has 3 major glitches (including a wrong warp) that are used to complete the game around 15 minutes faster compared to the No Major Skips category.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The second Playstation 1 game of the Harry Potter series, it follows the story of the books.
games.name: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

categories.description: Some form of demonstration on routing and the creative parts of speedrunning. Last year's showcase was very well received so I'm planning on doing something similar but different. Details pending.
categories.name: Showcase

games.description: Open ended stealth game. Very funny when played well.
games.name: Hitman: Blood Money

categories.description: In Any% you need to run get all the chicks in each level as fast as you can- get in and get out, most optimally avoiding coins and additional pick ups on route, using morts sprint ability.
categories.name: Any %

games.description: Mort the Chicken must save the chicks from the evil cube who have stolen them. Mort must defeat the cubes, save the chicks and have themselves a party. Mort runs, flys, spin dives, pecks and slaps the enemies and uses eggs to help achieve his goals. Are the cubes truly evil? is this all a huuuge misunderstanding?? who knows.. mort just wants to paty.
games.name: Mort the Chicken

categories.description: This category is the full completion, and sees us collect 10,000 gems, 14 talismans, and 64 orbs. We start with a boss rush using a series of tricks and glitches to get a fireball power-up, and then complete all of the levels in a specific order at high speed.

games.description: The second game in the Spyro the Dragon series. This run is the full completion category, where we will collect everything in the game to reach 100%. It's an incredible speedrun which combines a series of early-game tricks with specific routing and cool movement. This category was last run at ESA in July 2019, with various route changes since; it's only been run at an in-person marathon once since then (by me, at UKSG Red 2025).
games.name: Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage

categories.description: The goal of each stage is to find the keys to unlock the door, then reach the door to progress. Each stage has an optional carrot that's often hidden somewhere. This category requires to collect the carrot on every stage.
categories.name: All Carrots (100%)

games.description: An indie developed puzzle-platformer. The unique part of the game is that you collect pieces you can later place into the level to assist your platforming. What makes the run very fun is the amount of ways puzzles can be solved, and there's also some cool glitches. The goal of each stage is to find the keys to unlock the door, then reach the door to progress. And since it's an indie game, it is a great way of showing that the NES is still receiving new games to this day!
games.name: Gruniozerca 2 - The Great Cavy Rescue!

categories.description: The runners play a game. When a donation comes in, the game switches to another in the game pool.
categories.name: Donation Shuffler

games.description:
The exact game list isn't decided yet but similar to last year it'll probably be 5 NES games and two teams. Whenever a team beats one of the games, it's taken out of the shuffler and the team gets a point. Whoever has the most points in the end wins. 
New for this year is that we'll keep a count of donation sums too. Larger donations will cause multiple shufflers over time. This to avoid the problem of people getting their cards marked as suspicious due to numerous transactions in a short time.
games.name: NES Shuffler

categories.description: An extremely open version of the game where all chests and bosses have random rewards that include, Combo Modifiers, Support Abilities, Weapons, Armour, Accessories, Magic, Summons and most importantly, the 3 "Proofs", which we need to hunt down and aquire to gain access to the final boss rush!
categories.name: Randomizer

games.description: Every early 2000s gamer's joy and *objectively* the best Kingdom Hearts game in the series!
games.name: Kingdom Hearts II

categories.description: Highly optimised route from New Game to final boss with a character specific story and end dungeon filled with tricks, AI Manipulations, routing choices and character progression. Perhaps featuring the amazing commentary from fellow runner Staratar, or even a race...?
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A unique take on Final Fantasy, bringing together all the main cast of heroes and villians in a 3d battle arena fighting game, filled to the brim with RPG elements to make you feel right at home.
games.name: Dissidia: Final Fantasy

categories.description: Defeat every Boss and mini-boss in the game! [Is Zaghnol a boss?] Including the Superboss Ozma and everyone's favourite Frog Chef Quale! Did we mention F-R-O-G-S?! Get ready for a rollercoaster of story, chocobos, frogs and mayhem!
categories.name: All Bosses

categories.description: A run in which we defeat one of the Final Fantasy series hardest secret bosses as fast as possible. First available within Disc 3 of the game. [Vod is of an All Bosses run, however the general concept is the same, with the difference of final time at boss defeation rather than the end of the game]
categories.name: Ozma%

categories.description: The Legendary return of the Solo Character Challenge - a challenge run where we only use a specific character whenever possible, proving the impossible in a game mainly designed for a full party. Showing the struggles and strategies to make it through the game successfully and in an RTA environment.
categories.name: Vivi% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: The EPIC runback of our best boy Vivi challenging all that FFIX has to offer while adding extra challenges along the way from the great people in the audience and at home for the low low price of TWENTY DOLLARS! All the fun to be had here at the perfect cozy Stream 2 run!
categories.name: Vivi $20% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: The Legendary return of the Solo Character Challenge - featuring the one character that we get to bring through the ENTIRE game! Including easy access to Fleeing from encounters to get through the game faster than other characters while utilising the Steal ability to get powerful equipment early!
categories.name: Zidane% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: Featuring everyones favourite underpowered White Mage as she powers through the game showing off that truly any character is capable of completing FFIX Solo given the right amount of care and planning! [Previous ESA run Video lost to time]
categories.name: Garnet% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: Our trusted protector of the kingdom sets out to bring his princess back home. However her HP is always at zero and we're somehow on a grand world wide adventure the save the world...did not sign up for this... [Video lost to twitch purge </3]
categories.name: Steiner% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: Using a combination of uniquely themed Dragoon and Red Mage abilities, Freya engages the Solo Character Challenge with a skillset to show off just how powerful a character can become when using and abusing all that the game as to offer! [Video lost to twitch purge </3]
categories.name: Freya% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: Lets be honest, people are going to donate to catch frogs...so...many...frogs... Quina's Blue Magic provides a unique and welcome showcase across all of FFIX, where we have to not only battle the opponents, but sometimes, ourseleves...
categories.name: Quina% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: While joining the party fairly late compared to most characters, Eiko continues to showcase the power that a White Mage can bring to the Solo Character Challenge. Hosting a different set of skills and abilities from her counterpart Garnet! [A video for this one! Run was on EMU which adds an hour]
categories.name: Eiko% [Solo Character Challenge]

categories.description: Relating more similarly to the Eiko run, Amarant is the latest addition to the roster. However that does not stop him from showcasing his own way of getting through the rest of the game as efficiently as possible!
categories.name: Amarant% [Solo Character Challenge]

games.description: Massively loved JRPG by Square Enix. A love letter to the series as a whole up to that point. Filled with a cast of loveable characters and a classic RPG story. Final Fantasy is always a good time for all involved.
games.name: Final Fantasy IX

categories.description: Any% is the normal beat the game category. The video linked is actually for a side category of "No Red Propeller" which is just a slightly harder version of the Any% run.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Go Go Gadget SNES! This quirky platformer is a rush of weapon and gadget swapping, with some humor mixed in. A platformer with some cool tricks and abilities to skip parts of the level with the right pathing and items.
games.name: Inspector Gadget

categories.description: This is the main category of the game, and also the fastest. This easy difficulty allows for death warps, item skips, and fast paced gameplay.
categories.name: Any% Newborn

games.description: A brand new licensed NES game in the year 2024! For Real! Pulling at our nostalgia strings, this Rugrats game feels like it would have existed and fit perfectly back in our childhood. There is an HD version of this game that released too, but the original design is the NES version. Control Tommy, Chuckie, Lil, and Phil through multiple levels with similar styles to SMB2. Great music, gameplay, in level character swaps, and just a super fun step back in time.
games.name: Rugrats: Adventures in Gameland Rugrats: Adventures in Gameland

categories.description: Any runner can be a part of our live tutorial, a possible suggestion is we have a representative from our charity organization play and can also utilize the time to talk about all the good work the organization does for the community. Could even be good for a hosting segment as well to promote.
categories.name: Any% Live World Record Tutorial

games.description: A speedrun marathon tradition, every live event Home Alone is taught to new runners, and after the week is over, an influx of tied world records are submitted to the leaderboard. In this showcase we will be showing off a glitch that allows players to freeze Marv and Harry in order to be completely safe and survive the 20 minute timer, which will allow the first time runner to learn the game live on stream and get a live world record.
games.name: Home Alone

categories.description: This category is the standard beat the game category. There are some tricks to skip portions of levels, but for the most part you see most of the game in this run.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Another Simpsons game for the NES that follows the typical formula. Some weird and janky graphics and controls leads to some tough gameplay. This time you play as Bart's alter ego and fight super villains to help Radioactive Man save the world. There are plenty of interesting enemies and levels to see along the way which some classic Simpsons characters.
games.name: The Simpsons: Bartman Meets Radioactive Man

categories.description:
Rounds go until a racer wins 3 tracks, the time limit can change based on tech's/organizer's needs.

This showcase is similar to the Mario Battle Royale Showcase from ESA Summer 2023: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5_BCb4PrSe0
categories.name: Multiplayer Competition Showcase

games.description: Micro Machines is a 4 player SNES game where players race around a track trying to take the other racers out. Points are gained by being the last remaining vehicle. There are 30 tracks and players get to compete in cars, trucks, buggies, boats, helicopters, and more. Rounds will be tallied to determine the final overall winner in an annual ESA pastime that can be heard from the hallways as the practice room fills with miniature racers.
games.name: Micro Machines 2: Turbo Tournament

categories.description: This is a Co-op relay where players will do one stage each for 4 classic Mario games. First will be Super Mario Bros.  1, 2, and 3 on NES, and then ending with Super Mario World on SNES. This will use any% categories without wrong warps.
categories.name: Stage Relay Showcase

games.description: Another entry into an ESA tradition of multi-player relays. This one will involve not just one game but 4 classic Mario games. Super Mario Bros. 1, 2, 3 on NES and Super Mario World on SNES. Each player will do one stage each, leading to a run where a ton of players will be involved to complete a marathon run together.
games.name: Classic Mario Series

categories.description: The goal is to get to the credits of GT Mode by winning the GT World Championship. To get there, you need to collect all 3 Licences (B, A, I-A) and win Sunday Cup, Clubman Cup and GT Cup to unlock the World Champ. Using or selling the cars won from getting all golds in the licences is not allowed.
categories.name: Any% (No Licence Prizes)

categories.description: The goal is to beat Arcade Mode, which is achieved by winning a race on all 8 tracks on all 3 classes (A, B and C). Race order is determined by the strange way you unlock new cars in this mode. Physics differ compared to GT Mode for US and EU releases: cars do have twice more grip in Arcade Mode.
categories.name: Arcade

games.description: The first game of the franchise, that instantly became a hit. Released alongside the DualShock controller in 1997, the game was instantly a massive hit and boosted the success of the PlayStation. I personally this game is also partly responsible of the skyrocket prices rise for used japanese cars from the 90s.
games.name: Gran Turismo

categories.description: The goal is to beat Ryo Watanabe and become the Showdown King! To do that you need to progress through the race days as fast as possible, which will be mostly about abusing the drift physics and the shortest drag events. Some tresholds are quite difficult to pass, making this run very challenging
categories.name: Career Any%

categories.description: The goal is to become the street King by defeating all 5 kings: Grip, Drag, Drift, Speed and Showdown King. To unlock their paths, you need 10 track records in their specialty which needs a reroute as well as playing extensively in all game modes the game has to offer.
categories.name: Career All Kings

games.description: The game keeps the street racing vibes of the previous games but take them to the legal scene, now we race on proper tracks on proper Race Days.  The game has a very unique progression system where you gotta win points in a race day in order to win or dominate it. The main goal is to drive as few events as possible to met those tresholds. In races, points depend on your Time, your Car model and its upgrades, while for drifts it's directly tied to your drift score.
games.name: Need For Speed: ProStreet

categories.description: The goal is to beat all 34 driving missions the game has to offer. You start with overtaking missions, then 3 laps race with handicap, then slipstream battles and finally 1-lap faceoffs with handicap. The final mission and the Skyline slipstream battle are the 2 hardest in the run.
categories.name: All Driving Missions

games.description: The most complete racing game on the PS2. Graphics way ahead of its time, physics far ahead of any other console game at the time, and an astronomic amount of content. One of the most iconic games of the franchise.
games.name: Gran Turismo 4

categories.description: The goal is to finish the Career Mode by beating Darius. To get there we need to conquer territories until we own the entire city while solving the main plot. The route tries to optimize the time spent on track and in the menus, as well as getting the better cars and upgrades at our disposal.
categories.name: Career Any% (NG)

games.description: Sequal of Most Wanted and last game of the "golden era" of NFS after both Underground games and Most Wanted, we are back into street racing at night. This time the gimmicks are around canyon races on technical tracks and local gangs battling for territories in Palmont City. The storyline could also well have been used in a sort of Fast&Furious ripoff.
games.name: Need For Speed: Carbon

categories.description:
Now about the category : Boss Blackout... 
Well it is a bingo category so instead of trying to fight the final boss we have a grid of 25 objectives to do.
But there is a twist to that classic system : Each time we defeat one of the bosses of the game we get a free instant objective.
categories.name: Randomizer - Boss Blackout

games.description:
The randomizer is based on Golden Sun : The Lost Age developped by Camelot and published in 2002 on GBA.
It is a RPG game recognized by his puzzles and specific class system.

What is randomized ? 
Well, almost everything:
- items
- psynergies
- djinns
- and characters

More info on the start of the submit video (10 minutes of presentation, then a full run)
games.name: Golden Sun : The Lost Age

categories.description: The randomizer makes the game from a linear story to an open world experience. We need to find 4 mystic statues to be able to finish the game by going through the different dungeons. The options added ensure almost all the world is open with a quick warp system for a non stop experience.
categories.name: Randomizer - 4 statues - Open World - Dark Space Warp

games.description: Illusion of Gaia, the second game of the Soul Blazer Trilogy where we follow the young Will in his travel to discover the truth of the world and its ancient ruins. With a combination of level design, skills unlocks through the game and iconic monsters through the mythological ruins of the world, we embark on an adventure.
games.name: Illusion of Gaia

categories.description: Co-Op Any% is a cooperative category which can feature 2, 3 or 4 players to complete the run. We will be using 2 players and we have chosen the best of the best (in Europe): Yisk and Oggy.
categories.name: Co-Op Any%

games.description:
Borderlands 2 is a magnificent looter-shooter released in 2012 and is known for its humorous dialog, replayability and distinctive look due to the art style of the game featuring cell-shading.

The run has three main techs that is utilized during the entire run: dialog skip using ECHO-Logs (items in game featuring lore or information), infinite-ammo glitch and off-host speed-stacking. These techs make the game  which on average would be 30 hours to complete, down to 1 hour 30 minutes!
games.name: Borderlands 2

categories.description:
About the video link : The run starts at 4:48:00 and ends with the incentive at 6:25:00
All details about this category is greatly commented by BowieTheHero in the video. You can also find all details here : https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-0LxQ2D56OxOlFbn2SUF3C2ePn7uhsrT
categories.name: Any % normal

categories.description: This run is extremely fast, as you kill almost all your enemies in a single shot thanks to perfectly optimised equipment. It's all about getting the rng right in random battles and knowing the route perfectly.
categories.name: New Game + Hard

games.description: Crisis Core Final Fantasy VII Reunion is the remastered version of the PSP game and a prequel to FFVII. Runs consist mainly of having good strategies for bosses, optimised equipment and a lot of luck with RNG (because the level rise of our character and his equipment is partly RNG).
games.name: Crisis Core Final Fantasy VII Reunion

categories.description: Perfect Chain% is a category where we need to finish the game as fast as possible without missing a single note.
categories.name: Perfect Chain % Expert

categories.description: Finish the game as quickly as possible. The difficulty of ultimate mode lies in the fact that our characters are level 1 at the start, so any mistake could easily lead to a game over.
categories.name: Any% Ultimate

categories.description:
I propose a showcase of some of Final Fantasy's best-known music in the game's most difficult mode (supreme mode).
Here's a video example of some of the music in supreme modes. (I am still improving each day my level)
categories.name: Showcase

games.description: TFBL is a rhythm game featuring music from the Final Fantasy series and other Square Enix titles.
games.name: Theatrhytm Final Bar Line

categories.description: Beat all the missions on the hardest difficulty
categories.name: Legendary

games.description: Shooter game on the hardest difficulty with cool tricks and skips.
games.name: Halo: Reach

categories.description: Any% has lots of interesting sequence breaking tricks. There are a good amount of cutscenes in the run so there is good down time for donations, but the sequence breaking and glitches makes it very interesting for a casual viewer. The bowser fight at the end is notorious.
categories.name: Any% (No ACE)

categories.description: Reverse All Cards is a run where we collect each star spirit from all the chapters in backwards order, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, and then finally 1. then we have to go on to beat the game. This is a testament to how truly broken the game is. While its really cool its possible, its honestly not too difficult
categories.name: Reverse All Cards

games.description: Paper Mario is a classic beloved RPG with lots of colorful characters and witty dialogue. It has different sections of the game divided into chapters, resulting in very linear casual playthrus, but the any% speedrun is full of sequence breaking glitches. Theres a very difficult fight right at the end of the run which makes this an exciting category.
games.name: Paper Mario

categories.description: Any% is basically just a string of tricks and skips in each individual level. there are no chapter sequence breaks but the constant tricks in each level keeps things very interesting. While some tricks are complex a lot of them are simple which make it easier for viewers to understand
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Super Paper Mario is the 3rd installment of the Paper Mario series, and is a combination of an RPG and a Platformer. Unique gameplay helps this game standout but so does the touching story most players remember it for. the any% run beats all chapters in order, but there are numerous cool tricks and skips in almost every level. There are lots of cutscenes which gives plenty of time for donations.
games.name: Super Paper Mario

categories.description: This game is already amazing enough at entertaining a crowd, and I would add to the experience by pulling out every stop possible. This would be 90 minutes of straight crowdwork where I put my years of entertaining to the test. The estimate is flexible if 90 minutes is too much.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: This game is chaos incarnate. In theory, it's simple. Answer math questions, collect notebooks, and leave the school. In practice, it's a horror. Baldi chases you all around the school while several RNG-based characters all try to get in your way. Completing this game normally is hard enough. Completing a speedrun of it is nearly impossible. This would be a 90 minute showcase where I'm just as likely to beat the entire game in 4 minutes as I am to not beat it at all.
games.name: Baldi's Basics in Education and Learning

categories.description: Mod added before unleashed by the developper, Mania mod has lot of enemy and speed increaded X2 than hardest mod also more aggresive and i decide to go with my boy Skate its a little guy but lot of skill
categories.name: Skate Mania Mod

games.description:
Unleashed On 1992, Side-scroller beat em ups, your goal is defeated MR.X and save Adam Hunter ( Skate's brother) 

Lot of random battle of my childhood game one of my favourite game and loved speedrun this game.
games.name: Streets Of Rage 2

categories.description: Most Popular on Streets of Rage 2 Leaderboard Skate and Max are good user in this category this guys seems different power for Max and speed for Skate but pure skill for Max and Skate
categories.name: Skate Normal Mod

games.description:
Unleashed On 1992, Side-scroller beat em ups, your goal is defeated MR.X and save Adam Hunter ( Skate's brother) 

Lot of random battle of my childhood game one of my favourite game and loved speedrun this game.
games.name: Streets of Rage 2

categories.description: In any% we will be using diffrent glitches to traverse the levels. This can be anything from storing coordinates into diffrent levels to teleport to the end, vaulting of diffrent edges to make massive jumps or ramming yourself into corners to be flung out.
categories.name: Any%

games.description:
Skylanders Spyros Adventure is a toys to life adventure game. Controlling the games heroes the skylanders players will traverse 22 unique levels. In these Levels players will be solving puzzles, fighting enemies and performing simple platforming to gather the sources to the core of light, to help in the final showdown with the main villian Kaos.  

The run itself features a wide variety of height exploits, varied movement, combat and the powerfull ability to teleport around the diffrent levels.
games.name: Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure (Wii/WiiU) Skylanders: Spyro's Adventure (Wii/WiiU)

categories.description: The outrageously difficult category jak 1 any% has never been seen at a marathon before. This run could either be a 15 minute blitz through the game skipping almost everything using the most difficult skips in the Jak series, or it could be a train wreck where we're stuck for 50 minutes.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The classic playstation 2 collectathon platformer Jak and Daxter! (This time with a bouncy twist)
games.name: Jak and Daxter: The Precursor Legacy

categories.description: In Sapphire Any% Glitchless, you run through the entire game, but take advantage of RNG Manipulations to get the best Pokémons stats you can. We will do 3 manipulations for 3 pokémon in this run. And we will also manipulate some catches to skip the Masterball  !
categories.name: Any% Glitchless

games.description: Pokemon Sapphire is the first of the Generation 3 Pokemon games, and the first to feature the Hoenn region! Your goal is to fight all eight Gym Leaders, the Elite Four, and the Champion, while also stopping Team Aqua and their plans to flood the world. This game has the Mach Bike, which is one of the fastest bikes in the Pokemon series, making for fast-paced, exciting movement !
games.name: Pokémon Sapphire

categories.description: Over the last few years, the Any% category has been constantly renewed, with its share of glitches specific to each route. The US version will be favored in this few-second category over the PAL and JAP versions. The Any% category is famous for its Palace Skip.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Paper Mario TTYD on Gamecube is the second opus in the Paper Mario RPG saga. The Any% category is now under 2h20 and offers an atypical route with (many) major glitches. The version of the game is not a compulsory aspect, but there are big differences between the US, PAL and JAP versions.
games.name: Paper Mario : The Thousand Year Door

categories.description: The Manipless (No RNG Manipulation) category is very popular among DS speedrunners as it's very accessible, while also requiring lots of skill to master. Our team will include Cyndaquil, Fearow?? and a legendary fish! Tweaking allows us to perform plenty of skips, but this makes Red and Blue tough!
categories.name: Any% Manipless

games.description: Pokémon HG/SS are remakes of the iconic Gold/Silver, released in 2009. We venture through the Johto region, and are eventually able to reach the Kanto region after becoming the Champion! After getting 16(actually 5) badges, one final battle remains...
games.name: Pokémon SoulSilver

categories.description: Any% is actually a relatively new category, with the first useful glitch being found less than 2 years ago. Unlike many Pokemon Any% runs, you still play through the entire game, but take advantage of glitches to catch a much stronger Pokemon early on in the game. This new route features Tentacool!
categories.name: Any%
