games.description: Pokemon Sapphire is the first of the Generation 3 Pokemon games, and the first to feature the Hoenn region! Your goal is to fight all eight Gym Leaders, the Elite Four, and the Champion, while also stopping Team Aqua and their plans to flood the world. This game has the Mach Bike, which is one of the fastest bikes in the Pokemon series, making for fast-paced, exciting movement.
games.name: Pokemon Sapphire

categories.description: Previously labeled as "Popcorn%" due to the multitude of unskippable cutscenes, TR5 Any% has become one of the quintessential TR classics run. With 4 distinct stories told, each one showcases very different strategies and glitches, including setting Lara on fire for minutes at a time while.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: The final of the classic PS1-era TR games and one of the subjects of recent remasters, the OG entry was plagued by low development team morale, after they were forced to continue producing titles for a series they wanted to kill off with this game's predecessor. While the tale of this game is both an intriguing and a tragic one, the speedrun has become one of the most diverse in the TR catalogue, almost serving as a "best of" of all tricks and strategies found in all of the previous entries.
games.name: Tomb Raider Chronicles

categories.description: While the general movement heavily relies on running jumps as its fastest option, this run also showcases glitches unique to the first game, such as zipping up platforms by jumping at them from precise locations, or Lara traverses "the void", levitating to the top of the level with blind inputs.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: It doesn't get more OG than the original Tomb Raider - and it shows. With only the basic movement and the very first iteration of the game's engine in place, the first game is very punishing to run and heavily relies on set movement lines and patterns. Even small deviations can lead to bonks that slow down the run significantly - small adjustments are almost impossible to make. Despite this, the game already introduces many of the best known glitches and tricks in the series from  the get go.
games.name: Tomb Raider

categories.description: 32 Track with items promises to be a chaotic fun filled speedrun on its own, with the addition of making it a race there is added drama and more donation opportunities as suggested in the box above.
categories.name: 32 Track (No Skips, Balanced Items)

categories.description: 32 Track with items promises to be a chaotic fun filled speedrun on its own. The items give added chances for donation opportunities as suggested in the box above.
categories.name: 32 Track (No Skips, Balanced Items)

games.description: MKW is a beloved childhood game that was known for being the number 1 best selling game for the Wii console. This speedrun specifically takes you through every track the game has to offer and the (with items) allows the player to use, and get hit by, every item in the game. This makes for great viewing, close races and the posibilites for either racer to make a great last minute comeback.
games.name: Mario Kart Wii

categories.description: Standard Any% category, where you beat all stages as fast as possible. Game has interesting mechanics of collecting bones and one bone switches for another powerup choice making runner count and collect proper number of bones to alter between bombs and barking, when necessary.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Another solid NES game developed by Atlus based on popular Hanna-Barbera cartoon under the same title. Although Wacky Races is cartoon about racing, game is platformer , where you take control of Mutley on his way to disturb all racers and make him and Dastardly win the race (what very surprisingly doesn't happen in the end). To achive this goal, player will run through 10 diverse stages, throwing boms , barking at enemies and using tail to fly (Mutley's special mark from other cartoon).
games.name: Wacky Races

categories.description: Normal is main difficutly level in this game. There is secondary easy difficulty, whch is almost the same in terms of speedrun. Commentary will be provided by the best aussie retro runner Lucha_Gym.
categories.name: Normal

games.description: This is famicom only sequel to Kung Fu on NES. Game is superior to its sequel making stages very distinguishable and improving gameplay to smoother less clunky experience. Again, you have to spoil the plans of mister in dark clothes , who this time is leader of smugglers, dealers etc. Speedrun consist in using well timed kicks and punches in the air to not stop your forward movement killing spawning enemies and reacting to their RNG. There is as well uppercut move important during boss fights
games.name: Spartan X 2

categories.description: Standard Any% category, where you beat all stages as fast as possible. In this category, mostly Plucky and Furball are utilized, where first one can fly and second can climb wall making possible to skip some sections in certain levels.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: It's old Konami, it's NES and it's Tiny Toons, so it has to be good. Great fast paced platformer, where you take control of Buster, Plucky, Dizzy or Furball to save Babs from Montana Max. In speedrun, glitched speed is introduced , where you go even faster than intended making it one of most intense NES runs in terms of speed.
games.name: Tiny Toon Adventures

categories.description: Standard Any% category, where you beat all stages as fast as possible. In this category, mostly rat animal is utilzied, which makes you run significantly faster.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Well made less known NES title by Atlus based on also less known cartoon of the same name, whichit may look like scrapped idea from Jetsons franchise. Game at first resembles basic slow paced paltformer , where you walk, shoot and traverse through different planets to save universe from your evil twin Ratchet. However, it's strongest asset comes from transformation into different animals with different abilities, which changes pace of the game and strategy significantly.
games.name: Widget

categories.description: One loop cateogry until stages start to repeat.
categories.name: Beat phase 12

games.description: Simple but fun game, where you defeat waves of enemies by stepping on their balloons and popping them.
games.name: Balloon Fight

categories.description: Any% beats the game without regard to collectables
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: 100% collects all essence, breaks all crystals and completes each level within it’s speedrun timer.

games.description: Evergate is a level based 2D puzzle platformer that follows Ki through their memories of life. The games main gimmick is a soulflame mechanic that allows you to connect with different crystals, each with their own unique ability. The run rapidly uses these crystals in sequence to fly through levels in unintended ways.
games.name: Evergate

categories.description: Ninja Tracks are user made tracks which are much harder than the developer made tracks. They require mastery of unintended advanced techniques and extreme precision. In this showcase we'll go through a selection of increasingly difficult Ninja tracks.
categories.name: Ninja Showcase

games.description: Trials Rising is the most recent entry in the Trials series, an ultra high skill cap physics platformer. Ride your bike with the only controls being accelerate, break and lean and get over increasingly difficult obstacles.
games.name: Trials Rising

categories.description: This is the first set of races in the game, in the slowest/oldest cars. It's also the shortest era to play through.
categories.name: group 2

categories.description: group b is probably the most iconic era of historic rally, where the cars were ridiculously fast and the safety regulations were not there. We can relive this era in art of rally through the fourth chapter in the game.
categories.name: group b

games.description: art of rally is a rally racing game that's all about the vibes.  With really cool art style and music, we'll journey through the history of rally while racing across different parts of the world. Each category is a different era of rally. The funny about this game as a speedrun though is... every championship chooses random tracks, so there is a huge amount of rng due to this. But we can sort of manipulate it by resetting championships tactically...
games.name: art of rally

categories.description: In this run, I'll play the co-op mode for 2 players, but play both players myself, with one PS3 move controller in each hand! This makes things much trickier and sillier.
categories.name: 1p2p all levels

games.description: This is the PS3 port of the arcade railshooter Deadstorm Pirates. It uses the PS3 move controller as the lightgun. It's by the developers of Time Crisis, it's excessively silly (which some incredible so-bad-its-funny voice acting), but also with loads of cool, varied levels, enemies and boss fights. I would have the world record sweep in this game but I don't have capture card for PS3 :(.
games.name: Deadstorm Pirates

categories.description: Any% Warps is the fastest category, where we will break the game heavily with a myriad of glitches and skips, while gaining access to more and more movement techniques which we'll use to zoom through the game in no time.
categories.name: Any% Warps

games.description: Dust is a beautiful 2D solodev metroidvania from 2012. It's very fast paced, and focused on its movement and combat.
games.name: Dust: An Elysian Tail

categories.description:
Hitman Roulette Routing Competition
We have been doing only 1 mission per week to keep it casual, and have a weekly reveal where we react to eachothers runs
But this submission would be 2 teams in multiple missions. segmented runs will be shown back to back per mission. First to 3 wins win
categories.name: Roulette Run Invalid

games.description: Hitman is a game where you fool npcs into being blind
games.name: Hitman World of Assassination

categories.description: Obtains best ending by doing all the required quests in the game.  Game speed is quite hardware dependent so estimate includes a bit of an extra buffer due to unknown hardware. Video is from old outdated route currently.
categories.name: True Ending (Hard)

games.description: RPG of the year 2024. Combines a lot of really great JRPG elements from both, the Persona series as well as the SMT series to create a phenomenal experience. While a lot of inspiration is drawn from Persona games, given it's made by the same creators, it doesn't suffer the exact same downtime issue for a speedrun setting, making it a great showcase overall.
games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio

categories.description: Any% is the most well known and explored category in the game, taking roughly an hour with some very cool tricks and movements. In the past few years only minor new strats where found, however those new strats vastly increase difficulty but also the intricacy of the run.
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: Any% race between 2 teams of 2 Runners
categories.name: Any%

categories.description: In Dark Side the objective is to colect 250 Moons and then defeat the boss rush on the Dark Side of the Moon. While the amount of Moons to be collected is double the amount of Any%, there are lots of very fast moons to get extra, so it takes only about 45 minutes longer.
categories.name: Dark Side

categories.description: In All Moons the objective is to collect... well, all 880 Unique Moons in the game. During the about 8 Hours of the run there is barely any breaks due to cutscenes, which makes for a fairly fast paced run in relation to how long it is.
categories.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: 100% is generally speaking not as popular as All Moons. This is due to the most extra part of 100% being coin grinding to be able to buy all the outfits, which takes roughly 1 Hour in total time split over 2 parts. Good comms can make this part entertaining! Additionally you have to get all purples!

games.description: Super Mario Odyssey is still the newest installation of the classic 3D Mario franchise. (Hopefully not for long anymore) With its intricate movement options and well designed worlds, as well as glitches and exploits, SMO serves as a prime example of a fun to play and watch speedgame with a high skill ceiling.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: Any% Restricted aims to complete the game as fast as possible, using out of bounds tricks etc. "Grab boosts" are not allowed which happen when grabbing an enemy from behind a lower piece of collision.
categories.name: Any% Restricted

games.description: The game is a first person action adventure where the player experiences the world through the eyes of Indiana Jones with all the puzzle solving and whip cracking one could assume. The run relies on reaching level progression triggers by either using minor glitches or out of bounds movement. Some levels are skipped almost completely with out of bounds tricks.
games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle

categories.description: In Any% we go through the game collecting exactly the amount of bots we minimum need to complete the game. There is room for route changes from person to person and you still get to see a ton of good Astro Bot gameplay including some cool skips. For a first time ESA appearance Any% is perfect.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Astro Bot is a 3D platformer where you travel accross space to repair your mothership - the PS5. Throughout the game you collect parts of your PS5 to restore it and rescue your friends - other bots. Some of the bots are just regular bots meanwhile others are based on playstation characters and certain playstation characters even get entire levels based on them. Astro Bot won game of the year in 2024 and for good reason! I'd love to be able to show it off for the first time ever at a ESA :)
games.name: Astro Bot

categories.description: in Any% No Pause Buffer the use of "Pause Buffer" is banned - a broken glitch that can allow you skip some levels entirely. This means there is a higher focus on movement and utilizing multiple skips to get through levels fast. (Sorry for lag in the video my PC is bad - it will run fine on ESA PC's)
categories.name: No Pause Buffer

games.description: Sonic Omens is a 3D sonic fan game. It has both voice acting and cutscenes and the game plays like a mix of the Boost Sonic games and the Sonic Adventure games with a variety of different gameplay styles. It's a intense high speed game with tight platforming and lots of momentum based movement. A lot of stages have incredibly broken skips that has you going out of bounds or flying over giant gaps! The game has already appeared in multiple marathons but I'd love to show it off at ESA too :)
games.name: Sonic Omens

categories.description: In Good Ending the goal is to recruit enough of your friends to trigger the good ending where you all go and take on the true final boss. You get all upgrades, clear all missions and get most of the collectibles all while moving through all the worlds with precise routing and timing to make it work!
categories.name: Good Ending

games.description: Daichan's Great Adventure: ~ World's End is a Japanese 3D Touhou platforming game that plays like a blend of Super Mario 64, Legend of Zelda Ocarina of Time and Banjo Kazooie. You roll around at the speed of sound and generally do some really cool movement to pick up upgrades and help out friends. The game has a lot of interesting skips and optimized routing that makes for a surprisingly great speed game - as well as a perfect fit for the Touhou block ;)
games.name: Dai-chan's Great Adventure: World's End

categories.description:
Classic Any%. I took the liberty to have a bit of fun with the submission video, here is a full run: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y7LAr_jJPzU
The game audio will be more lively in the showcase, as playing on a source port will allow having voice lines without losing time, among other cool extras.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: ESA 2015 was my first speedrun marathon, so this will be my 10 year anniversary, and I would love to show how my first ever speedgame has developed since then. In that time I have learned a lot about the great Quake III style movement that this and the successor Star Wars Jedi Knight games by Raven enjoy, so in addition to other optimizations the run has gotten a lot flashier. Also, with help from that Jedi Knight community, several new cool tricks have been found that I would love to show off.
games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Elite Force

categories.description: Get the game's built-in progress counter up to its maximum value of 101%. This entails collecting all the skull gems and Precursor orbs scattered throughout the game, and even reaching the gold medal on all 6 dream minigames, but main missions are optional, which gives plenty of room for cool skips!

games.description: Daxter is a spin-off of the classic 3D platformer series Jak & Daxter, taking place between Jak 1 and 2. Jak has been captured by the Krimzon guard, leaving Daxter to rescue him, and fight a Metal Bug infestation along the way. The game is meant to be quite linear, but a few glitches break it wide open, letting us travel out of bounds, launch up in the air or even straight up teleport!
games.name: Daxter

categories.description: This category plays the map mob of the dead, the prison of alcatraz. The objective is to complete all of the steps for the easter egg, also commonly called the main quest. This involves unlocking the map, killing zombies in certain spots and times, and collecting items.
categories.name: Mob of the Dead Easter Egg

games.description: BO2 zombies is mainly split into 2 categories of activity. Movement: ground strafes, air strafes, wall strafes, strafe jumps and the like. The other part is navigating, surviving, and manipulating the zombies. Sometimes both at the same time. The player will kill zombies to collect points and complete objectives on the map.
games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops II Zombies

categories.description: Darker side is a category where the goal is to collect 500 moons and beat the darker side level.  The category consists of many unique glitches and trick only seen in this category and is my personal favorite category.
categories.name: Darker side

categories.description: All moons is a category where the goal is to collect every unique moon (exluding dublicates from the shop) in the game and then beat the final bowser fight unlocked as a result of getting all 880 moons. This category showcases everything the game has to offer along with category exclusive glitches.
categories.name: All Moons

games.description: Released in 2017  for the nintendo switch, Super Mario Odyssey is a game where the goal is as usual to save peach from bowser. The main game game ends in moon kingdom after defeating bowser, but the game consists of as many as 880 unique moons in total.  some bonus stages are also available after collecting a certain amount moons.
games.name: Super Mario Odyssey

categories.description: From a fresh file, beat the game while collecting all of the Gold Bolts, the special collectible throughout the game. The focus on the Gold Bolts throughout the run introduces some unique strats that aren't typically used in the Any% run, such as Jasindu Rail Skip, Visiclips, and more.
categories.name: All Gold Bolts

categories.description: NG+ allows you to replay the game from the start, but with your weapons, bolts, etc. intact. As such, we have all our movement options with the Shock Ravager and Razor Claws  from the start. It's very fast-paced and tech-heavy as a result, with nearly every level having a really big skip.
categories.name: NG+

categories.description: A very precise route that spans the entire first playthrough? 140 total weapon levels grinded in 8 minutes? A file manip that skips over half of the entire second required playthrough? This category really does have it all!

games.description: The first game of the "Future series", Tools of Destruction has a unique identity among the Ratchet series as a game that marries the mechanics of the original trilogy and the later future games. Whole level skips are present through the run, and weapons such as the Shock Ravager and Razor Claws make up the backbone of the movement.
games.name: Ratchet & Clank: Tools of Destruction

categories.description: This run is similar to an OoT glitchless run. there are a few skips with the hookshot but you cannot really sequence break like in Any% so you do all the temples and trials like in real OoT.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: I have showcased the any% run at last year's summer and quite a few people asked me to submit the full run. It is lengthy for a marathon submission and it does not feature a lot of glitches, the fascination will come from the viewers seeing the details and the fantastic work the author of the map did when re-creating every little aspect of ocarina of time. You just want to watch the run to find out how he made the next item/temple/boss look :)
games.name: Ocarina of Time in Minecraft

categories.description: Could also do all bosses or all achievements, they just make the run slightly different.
categories.name: Beat the Game

games.description:
You start as a baby, live through youth, adulthood and grow old.
Overall a pretty realistic simulation of life.
Funny, quirky, short, entertaining, what more could you ask for?
games.name: Live

categories.description: One big glitch lets us skip the majority of the game but there is still enough left to leave an impression on the viewers. They will get the gist of the game and possibly the urge to play the game casually afterwards without the whole game being spoiled to them.
categories.name: Any% No SLA

categories.description: This cat essentially shows the entire game but played quickly. Will be entertaining enough for about 7 minutes of gameplay
categories.name: Glitchless No SLA

games.description:
Cool little puzzle game where you have to do some creative drawing in order to find the solutions:)
Innovative, short and fun. Great marathon showcase. The kinda game where those who have played it will love to see it broken and those who havent heard of it will get the urge to play it
games.name: The Looker

categories.description: Any% is beating the game as fast as possible. The game doesn't have any major glitches but it's fast paced.
categories.name: any%

games.description: Classic platformer with tight controls and great music. "The RNG in this game is based on the electrical particles in the atmosphere, it's not manipulatable" - Yogidamonk. Truer words have never been spoken. I have played it hundreds of hours and have WR. Despite that the game can still play horrible tricks on me. Last ESA show of the game ended in disaster for me, this time I'm back for revenge raising the stakes by submitting as a race against Hirexen. Surely one of us will be able to finish?
games.name: Gremlins 2: The new Batch

categories.description: Glitchless is the toughest category of sotn main leaderboards because it requires for runner to have good knowledge of the game and be as efficient in mana usage as possible because it's the main resource in this run
categories.name: Glitchless Any%

categories.description: All bosses category has the runner visit most of the castle while obliterating the bosses of the game with shield rod and Alucard shield combo
categories.name: All Bosses

categories.description: All Bosses All Relics Save Richter. The most fun 100% type sotn run.
categories.name: ABRSR

categories.description: PS4 version of the game that has entirely new glitches and skips than original PSX/X360 version.
categories.name: Requiem Any%

categories.description: Lately sotn randomizer gained a lot of different presets all of which require different approach or even win conditions.
categories.name: Randomizer

games.description: Shield dashing, optimized bat movement and quick boss fights, all of that you're gonna see in this movement focused speedrun
games.name: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night

categories.description: Any% is basically collecting the "final" star of the mod, Comet Observatory 2. To unlock this galaxy, you need to collect 12 star to open the 2nd final galaxy and collect every Stamps from every galaxy, including the 2nd final galaxy.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Neo Mario Galaxy is a Super Mario Galaxy 2 Romhack made by Aurum. It's one of the 1st Mario Galaxy mod ever made, all the way back in 2017, but through the years it received 2 major updates. It shows many cool feature and ability that community made just for this game! This include... Stamps?
games.name: Neo Mario Galaxy

categories.description:
The goal is for all 4 players reach the credits in their respective games which requires finding multiple different key-items spanning the different games.
It's a very fun and neat way to do randomizers (with your friends)!
categories.name: 4 player co-op Multiworld Randomizer

games.description: Multiworld randomizer shuffles that game for multiple players. For example, in a two player multiworld, players A and B each get their own randomized version of a game, called a world. In each player's game, they may find items which belong to the other player.
games.name: Archipelago Randomizer (Ocarina of time, SM64, Pokemon Fire Red, Dark Souls 3)

categories.description: The any% category does a lot of sequence breaks to reach later-game dungeons early and eventually the final section of the game. Every digimon have their unique skills and abilities and in the co-op run we heavily utilize this to allow for us to beat the game heavily under-leveled and under-equipped
categories.name: any% (co-op)

games.description: Digimon World 4 is a hack&slash adventure game where you control a digimon exploring an unfamiliar world. There are tons of dungeons and bosses to find and you can even play with your friends! The speedrun starts off clipping OoB to reach a later dungeon to get quick level ups and unlock the "final dungeon" of World 1, after that we grind for levels in world 2 then perform a very precise trick to sequence break to the final World, from there it's an intense dungeon & boss rush to the end.
games.name: Digimon World 4

categories.description: The goal of All Dungeons is fairly simple: beat all the dungeons and collect their medallions/stones, then reach the end credits. After the initial setup to get all the items we need the run is an incredibly action packed and fast-paced dungeon rush where every fight is challenging and interesting.
categories.name: All Dungeons (no SRM)

categories.description:
Exploration bingo is where you start with only 2 goals on a 5x5 board of goals revealed, in order to reveal new goals you have to complete the ones you can see.
Blackout means we will complete the entire board of goals.
This will use heavy cooperation and planning between us as to who's doing what.
categories.name: Co-op exploration blackout bingo

games.description: Ocarina of Time is a Nintendo all-time classic known by many, showcasing the Hero of Time: Link as he embarks to save The Kingdom of Hyrule. This becomes an epic quest where you travel all over Hyrule as both a child and an adult doing sidequests, conquering dungeons and saving the land, however in the hands of speedrunners who know every little intricacy of the game this can be done incredibly fast with tons of flashy and interesting techniques.
games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of time

categories.description: Full game run. Run has some longer unskippable cutscenes, but it's still clearly mostly gameplay. Submission video is just the first half of the run, which I did at ESA Winter 24. I could maybe just do the 2nd half this time, but that would be kind of weird. But I'm open to it
categories.name: Full Game NG+

games.description: Groot and the bois save all the galaxies
games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy

categories.description: Go fast through walls by smashing yourself with wooden and metal boxes at illegal speeds. The run is quite high octane, as most of it is spent doing skips.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: 3rd person shooter with tons of skips that are possible by abusing mouse DPI and the telekinesis skill in the game. Classic
games.name: Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy

categories.description:
Fast and rather consistent category. By making clever use of Kugutsu mimics, you can get strong quickly and unleash really strong combos.
Bad ending doesn't have a final boss, so good ending is more interesting, though it's a weaker version than in other scenarios.
categories.name: Tsunanori Mido NG Good Ending (QoL Mod)

categories.description:
This is a highly volatile category where you might completely destroy your enemies, or they might destroy you.
There is no room for mistakes. You have to react to RNG correctly.
This category fights the true final boss, and with just 3/5 party members! (unless you get a rare drop)
categories.name: Bonnie & Formina NG (QoL Mod)

categories.description:
NG+ is vastly shorter but with the same core experience when you don't carry over anything.
NG+ results in some event RNG, so it varies what I run into.
Fairly consistent category due to mechs being tanky off of gear alone.
Casually considered to have the hardest final boss (with banging music).
categories.name: Diva No. 5 NG+ (No Carry Over) (QoL Mod)

categories.description: In case you would rather have an unmodded run, I'll submit this too. The runs are exactly the same but modded runs have faster cutscenes and UI animations.
categories.name: Tsunanori Mido NG Good Ending

categories.description: In case you would rather have an unmodded run, I'll submit this too. The runs are exactly the same but modded runs have faster cutscenes and UI animations.
categories.name: Bonnie & Formina NG

games.description:
The game consists of 5 protagonists with short individual stories for a JRPG.
The combat is very dynamic, requiring quick thinking on the spot. It's all about capitalizing on the RNG you get.
The community is currently working on a modded category to speed up cutscenes, which is what I'm submitting now, but I ran unmodded in the past.
The large amount of downtime is likely the reason the runs haven't been popular, but beneath that, or with the mod, they are very fun and dynamic runs.
games.name: SaGa: Emerald Beyond

categories.description: Completion of 5 platform levels any%
categories.name: Any%

games.description: A short but fun platform run based on the Home Alone 2 movie. Generally a humourous game. Involves a very challenging section involving 2 pixel wide beams with instant death if you don't make it creates some potential fun drama!
games.name: Home Alone 2

categories.description: Any% has the vast majority of the game's show-stopping tricks condensed in it. Most notably, the final 40 minutes of the run, World 6, is known as a gauntlet where almost every level has a major run killer, and many impressive skips are involved, leading to an exciting finish.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: Super Mario Galaxy 2 is an ambitious and expansive sequel to one of the most iconic 3D platformers, Super Mario Galaxy. Having been optimized by speedrunners over the years, the movement has gotten increasingly fast-paced and the skips even crazier. There are countless of ways to skip entire levels - including Yoshi's Infinite Flutter, performing precise Infinite Rock Jumps, or precisely moving toward the gravity of the next planet.
games.name: Super Mario Galaxy 2

categories.description: The neutral ending is the game's Any% category. After around the 20 minute mark, the Punch Card is obtained, which completely opens up the game, allowing for cutscene skips,  wrong warps and more. Towards the end, there is a tense fight with Asgore, where frame-perfect hits mean double the damage.
categories.name: Neutral

categories.description: True Pacifist is the more complete version of Neutral. Continuing where Neutral left off, you go through a technical Punch Card-heavy segment in True Lab, and end with the Asriel fight, wrapping up the whole experience with a feel-good ending.
categories.name: True Pacifist

games.description: Undertale is one of the most well-known indie RPGs from the 2010s, with its subversions from the usual JRPG format. Speedrunning-wise, it is most well known for the Punch Card Exploit, a glitch that completely breaks the game, allowing for a very technical speedrun.
games.name: Undertale

categories.description: The run focuses on "Movie Mode: Champ," the hardest difficulty, requiring precise combos, stamina management, and quick adaptation to AI behavior. Fast knockouts and minimizing damage are key for a smooth run. "Champ" is very extreme on RNG and how the AI plays the matches out. WR could happen live.
categories.name: Movie Mode: Champ

games.description: Rocky for the GameCube is a boxing game developed by Rage Software and based on the iconic Rocky movie franchise. Released in 2002, the game follows the journey of Rocky Balboa, from his humble beginnings as a club fighter to his legendary bouts against Apollo Creed, Clubber Lang, Ivan Drago, and more. The game combines arcade-style mechanics with a cinematic presentation, capturing the intense spirit of the movies.
games.name: Rocky (2002)

categories.description: KPDR (“old route”) is the original boss order of Super Metroid. I run the “newbie” version, which uses early Ice and Spazer beam. It’s harder to get a fast time, but with dedication and skill, I’ve pushed it to a sub-50. This run shows that even underestimated routes can impress.
categories.name: KPDR

categories.description: Map rando showcases speedrunning skill, deep SM knowledge, and problem-solving. With randomized rooms and items, it requires improvised routing while meeting different objectives like “kill all bosses or metroids.” It’s an exciting and novel way to play SM that keeps fans on the edge of their seats.
categories.name: Map Randomizer ("map randos")

games.description: Super Metroid is a nostalgic, high-skill game that blends tight movement, creative routing, and player expression. It’s thrilling to watch—fast-paced, volatile, and full of hype moments. With a low entry barrier and a high skill ceiling, it engages both newcomers and longtime fans. Its legacy and unpredictability make it a perfect fit for ESA, offering nonstop excitement and great opportunities for audience interaction and fundraising.
games.name: Super Metroid

categories.description: Similar to our last year's run except we start in the DLC and hunt for the key items called Messmer Shards. After obtaining enough of them from different major bosses, we can proceed to the final boss of the DLC and reach its final cutscene. All done as 2 Players 1 Controller.
categories.name: 2P1C DLC Randomizer

games.description: Elden Ring 2 Player 1 Controller. Similar run to what we did last year but with the 2024 DLC Shadow of the Erdtree ONLY! And with more practice! Submitting last year's VOD as we have not done this category as 2P1C yet.
games.name: Elden Ring

categories.description: Vortex is a fast-paced gauntlet of proxies, creative tricks, and out of bounds all in the goal of getting to the end portal, AKA "vortex", of each level as fast as possible. Recently elevated from misc to main catagory status due to its following of dedicated fans in the spyro community
categories.name: Vortex

games.description:
Spyro the Dragon is a popular collectathon 3D platformer for the Playstation 1. Spyro is a young dragon who must save the dragon worlds by collecting gems and saving his dragon comrades after gnasty gnorc turns all of them into crystal statues.
But collectables are slow and boring and going fast and hitting proxies is fun and cool so I play vortex :)
games.name: Spyro the Dragon

categories.description: Complete game fast. Back when I ran this before, we arbitrarily ran on hard difficulty, but now you can use any, so it's very likely I will run on Easy (and won't die as much). Getting to the end as soon as possible involves some cool skips in levels abusing the explosion physics.
categories.name: Any%

games.description: If I submitted this ages ago I'd have written "GTA clone" but it's more than that (and not really that either). A third person shooter (that happens to also have an open world with cars) from the 00's that's heavily about good gunplay (and running past enemies) and somewhat about point scoring (which is important during some of the run, honest). It's been a while since I ran this but it's also been a while since it's been at an ESA (Winter 2019) so thought it was time to showcase it again.
games.name: Total Overdose

categories.description: This is an Any% completion of game #33 of 50 in UFO50, Fist Hell. Fist Hell is a side-scrolling beat 'em up in the vein of games like Streets of Rage. Speed strategies mostly include memorising enemy spawns & clearing the screen ASAP, but there are a few tricks (e.g. ways to spawn less enemies).
categories.name: Fist Hell - Any%

categories.description: This is a "Gold Disk" completion of game #12 of the collection, Avianos. Avianos is a 4X-style strategy game with randomly generated maps, where you win by waging war & occupying more castles than the opponent. The "Gold Disk" consists of beating the first three missions in the campaign.
categories.name: Avianos - Gold Disk

games.description: UFO 50 is a collection of 50 different retro-style games, including a variety of different genres and game lengths. Each game in UFO50 is its own fully-fledged game, each with their own unique speedruns and strategies.
games.name: UFO 50

categories.description: A boost is when flicking both sticks up and down fast enough to where you get a boost out of it. In this run we do not do any boost so we try to use the start up animation as much as we can before the boost activates
categories.name: Any% no boost

games.description: Story is you are a little price of space and your mission from your Dad to roll up all this trash to create stars in the sky. Game controls are only both sticks on the controller where each stick controls each and of the prince

categories.description: same as Damacy, I can't shake the sticks to boost myself and in this is way more strickled. Also roll up the sun is basically any% with based opinion with a different name
categories.name: Roll up the sun (No Boost)

games.description: The sequel of Katamari Damacy swings even harder then the first, after completing his goal to recreate the stars in the sky, the King of All Cosmos was surprised to discover that he had many fans down on Earth. King of All Cosmos seeks to help fulfill the wishes of his fans—with the help from his son and his son's cousins, who again travel Earth, rolling things up into a Katamari.
games.name: We Love Katamari

categories.name: All Sectors + Any% showcase

This game is a beautiful mess

games.description: Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer. Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels! This game's movement is really cool and it's better the BOTW
games.name: Lil Gator Game

categories.description: The Full Game category shows everything Stranger of Paradise (SoP) has to offer. All story events are played as well as all the DLC missions with an exhilirating final boss gauntlet closing out the final 20 minutes of the run. Definitely the best way to experience this game.
categories.name: Full Game Hard Mode

games.description: Stranger of Paradise was developed by Team Ninja, which shows in its parallels to the Nioh franchise in terms of gameplay. After last years showcase of the Co-Op Any% Speedrun by denhonator, yidamoda and myself I am now putting forward the option to show the full game as there are countless amounts of mechanics that have not been showcased in previous showcases of this game.
games.name: Stranger of Paradise: Final Fantasy Origins

categories.description: Hard as a difficulty almost seems like a category built for either NG+ or completionists. The speedrun makes sure to get a big power boost by utilizing the in-game missions to get very strong gear very early, after which this mostly becomes a game of meticulous dodging and countering.
categories.name: Any% Hard

categories.description: Minerva% has the goal to beat the Super Boss of this game as fast as possible. This does not require beating the game itself making it vastly different from a usual run. After getting halfway through the game we're taking on around 60 missions to get to Minerva and beat her.
categories.name: Minerva%

games.description: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion is the prequel to Final Fantasy VII. The gameplay is vastly different to its sequel as it's an Action JRPG instead of a turn based game. It's fast paced, has cutscene skips and lots of small mechanics like damage storage and Buster Stance that make this run fast and fun to watch. Encounters are dodged through specific movement and Materia Fusion is used to amplify Zack's stats by a lot.
games.name: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion

categories.description: New Game Hard Mode has you facing against strong opponents which means efficient preparation and extensive use of many of the games interesting mechanics ranging from inheriting skills from previous generations to juggling in game events between so called "Time Skips".
categories.name: New Game - Hard

categories.description: New Game - Easy often uses an older version of the game which allows for a very strong item duplication glitch. Strong items are being rushed to the multiply those and putting them on all your characters allowing for a much more streamlined run.
categories.name: New Game - Easy

games.description: It's a JRPG in which the world and your character progression spans across multiple generations. Actions and events will have a permanent effect on future itterations of your characters and the people around you. This game's speedrun utilizes this inheretance mechanic to it's maximum potential by growing characters efficiently and learning skills in a timely manner. Skills are obtained through a random "Glimmer" giving every fight the potential for cool new moves to be unlocked.
games.name: Romancing Saga 2: Revenge of the Seven

categories.description: Any% Easy plays through the main quest in the easiest difficulty. This means we can be a lot more creative with our strats as enemies aren't able to hit us out of our own moves as much and less side stuff needs to be done to prepare for the games later events.
categories.name: Any% Easy

games.description: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth is the second part of the FFVII Remake Project. Rebirth has changed a lot of the mechanics compared to the original making the game a lot faster and more combo based than before thanks to Synergy Attacks. The run covers the main sections of the game with enough downtime for donations as well as great and easy to follow fights for viewers to enjoy.
games.name: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth

categories.name: Any%

games.description: The best James Bond game. Runs on the Iw4 Call of Duty engine which means strafe jumping and other quake-like movement tech! Also has super bouncing and massive oob skips similar to COD. Have learned the game but don't have a vid of my own PB yet so take one from my bud :D

categories.description: All 15 Daedric Quests, ending with the Sheogorath quest. This route was first performed live at GDQ Hotfix - MYOV this February.  Each of these quests has a level requirement up to 30, so an alchemy loop is done to level quickly, using the Nord Vampire/Bone Hawk Amulet variation of superstacking.
categories.name: All Daedric Quests

categories.description: All 50 achievements in the base game. The estimate may seem tight given my submission time, but I've massively optimized this category by running All Achievements +DLC, so getting consistently under 5:30 RTA won't be a problem when I implement those optimizations.
